He is tall, lean-faced, with a sharp jawline, a long narrow face, and distinctly single-lidded eyes (monolids) — handsome in a restrained, quiet way, looking slightly startled but composed. The impact is light but unexpected: she stumbles backward; he instinctively reaches out — one hand catches her upper arm, the other lands on the side of her waist (just above her hip), steadying her. In the collision, her hand jerks — the cup of shaved ice flies upward out of her grasp, spinning in the air. The camera shakes violently for a split second (the cameraperson reacting), then stabilizes in a close-up of their faces. Sound: the swish of fabric as they collide, a soft grunt of surprise from both (barely audible), then the distinct sound of the paper cup and spoon clattering as they leave her hand.
[Shot 9] At 21.5s, the world seems to slow down (DV-style slow motion, achieved through digital interpolation — slightly jittery, not smooth cinematic slow-mo). The two are locked in the position: his hand still on her waist, her free hand braced against his chest (where she instinctively placed it to steady herself). Her face is tilted up toward his; his is angled down toward hers. Their noses are approximately 2-3 centimeters apart — nearly touching. Time appears frozen. The background alley blurs into soft bokeh (DV's shallow depth-of-field when zoomed in). Her expression: wide eyes (slightly shocked), mouth slightly open, frozen mid-word — but her face shows no blush, only the surprise of the moment. His expression: equally still, eyes locked on hers, a flicker of something unreadable in his gaze. He has a small, barely noticeable mole under his left eye — visible in this close-up. No one moves. The camera is now completely still (the only perfectly still shot in the entire video). In the background, suspended in mid-air above them, the cup of shaved ice hangs frozen — its contents spilling out in slow motion: ice shards, red and green syrup droplets, and the small plastic spoon, all floating in the air like a frozen explosion of summer. The cup is upside down, ice crystals suspended in mid-fall, syrup droplets catching the sunlight like tiny stained-glass jewels. The spoon is mid-tumble, spinning slowly, a bead of syrup trailing behind it in a perfect arc. Sound: all environmental sounds drop out entirely — complete silence, as if the tape has momentarily lost audio — for approximately 1.5 seconds. Only the faint, high-pitched digital whir of the DV tape itself remains.
[Shot 10] At 25.0s, the slow motion continues. Her lips move — just a fraction — forming what could be the beginning of a word, maybe "죄..." (sorry), but it never completes. His eyes shift downward, briefly, to her lips, then back up to her eyes — a tiny, almost imperceptible movement. His fingers on her waist tighten ever so slightly (a micro-pressure, less than 0.5mm of movement) — the only indication that time hasn't completely stopped. In the background, the suspended ice and syrup remain frozen in mid-air — the cup still upside down, ice shards scattered like frozen diamonds, the spoon caught in a mid-spin, a single red syrup droplet hanging in the air like a tiny ruby. The camera holds this frame, locked on both of their faces, their noses separated by a breath's distance, the frozen summer explosion behind them.
[Shot 11] At 28.0s, the frame holds perfectly still — no camera shake, no drift, no autofocus hunt — for the first and only time in the entire video. The shot is a frozen close-up of both faces from a slightly low angle, his hand still on her waist, her hand still on his chest, their noses almost touching. His left eye (the one with the mole) has a tiny, warm reflection of the summer sky in it. Her lashes are visible, a few strands sticking together (summer humidity). Neither blinks. The tape seems to have stopped — a deliberate, unnatural stillness. In the background, the suspended ice shards, syrup droplets, and the spoon remain perfectly frozen in place, caught in the summer light.
[Shot 12] At 29.5s, the image begins to break down — a classic DV tape glitch: horizontal white lines flicker across the bottom of the frame, the color shifts to a faded pinkish-white, the edges of the frame start to pixelate into digital artifacts (not heavy, just suggestive). The sound, if any, is a faint digital whir and then nothing. At 29.95s, the glitch overtakes the frame — a brief white flash — and then the image freezes on the final frame: their noses, millimeters apart, his hand still on her waist, her wide eyes locked on his, and in the background, the suspended ice, syrup, and spoon frozen in mid-air, the hot summer afternoon held in amber. The screen holds this frozen frame until 30.0s. Then the screen goes black abruptly — no fade, just cut to black.
overall_soundscape: The soundscape shifts across three distinct sections. Section 1 (Shots 1-3): low-frequency hum of an old electric fan, layers of distant summer cicadas (매미) in the afternoon heat, faint street sounds (occasional distant car, neighborhood dog), the soft rustle of fabric from the subject's arm movement, and her quiet dialogue in Korean — soft, sleepy, slightly husky. Section 2 (Shots 4-7): transition to outdoor alley ambience — footsteps on concrete (scuffing sounds), a dog barking faintly in the distance, children playing somewhere blocks away, bicycle bells occasionally ringing, the distinct "clunk" of the convenience store door closing after she exits, the soft clink of the spoon against the paper cup, the subtle crunch of ice as she takes a bite, a soft "mm" hum of satisfaction, her laughter fading. Section 3 (Shots 8-12): a sudden drop into near-complete silence — the swish of fabric as they collide, the soft grunt of surprise from both (barely audible), the distinct sound of the paper cup and spoon clattering as they leave her hand, then all environmental sound cuts out. From Shot 9 onward, there is no ambient sound — only dead silence, with a faint high-pitched digital whir that could be the DV tape's own internal noise, becoming more prominent in Shot 12 as the glitch appears. No dialogue in the final scene except the unfinished "죄..." (implied, never spoken aloud). The silence itself is the dominant sound.
non_diegetic_music: N/A. No musical score whatsoever. The entire piece relies on ambient diegetic sound in the first two scenes and absolute silence in the final scene, emphasizing the "time stop" moment. The lack of music heightens the nostalgic, raw, handheld-documentary feel of the early DV aesthetic.

title: Time Space Train Voyage
prompt:
时长：30秒
画幅：16:9 横屏
形式：一个真正连续、无剪切、无跳帧的电影级长镜头
整体风格：好莱坞科幻冒险大片，超写实，宏大尺度，真实物理运动，电影级光影与景深，细腻胶片颗粒，高动态范围，冷暖色彩逐层变化。
主体：
一列现代而真实的城市列车，拥有一整面巨大的弧形全景玻璃窗。镜头位于车厢后部，以24mm广角斜向拍摄车厢前方：左侧三分之二是全景车窗，右侧三分之一是扶手、吊环和普通乘客。乘客穿现代深色通勤服装，起初安静低头看手机。列车、车厢结构、座椅、乘客位置、服装、镜头高度和焦段在30秒内始终保持完全一致。所有时空变化只发生在车窗之外。
ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE（0-30秒）：
0-4秒：
列车高速驶过阴天的现代城市边缘，窗外建筑、河道和电线杆形成真实的横向运动模糊。车厢灯光稳定，乘客低头看手机。镜头保持斜侧广角构图，只有轻微真实的列车震动。广播中传来冷静的女声：“时空列车即将启动，请勿离开座位。”
4-6秒：
列车进入昏暗隧道，城市被混凝土墙取代，顶部灯光快速扫过玻璃。车厢逐渐变暗。隧道墙连续变成粗糙潮湿的天然岩壁，利用贴近玻璃的岩石完成自然遮挡转场，绝不切镜。
6-12秒——恐龙纪元：
岩洞突然打开，窗外出现阳光穿透薄雾的史前雨林与辽阔侏罗纪山谷。成群副栉龙在列车旁奔跑，巨大的腕龙缓慢跨过远处树林，翼龙掠过天空。前景植物快速运动模糊，中景恐龙清晰，远景火山笼罩薄雾，形成强烈纵深和视差。
10秒时，一只体型巨大的霸王龙从树林冲出，与列车短暂并行，贴近玻璃发出震撼咆哮。乘客同时抬头、转向窗外，但没有夸张乱跑。金色阳光和森林绿色真实投射进车厢。
12-19秒——火山末日：
霸王龙巨大的身体从镜头前掠过，形成一次自然遮挡。遮挡结束后，同一片史前世界已经变成正在毁灭的火山荒原。远方超级火山剧烈喷发，黑色火山云翻滚上升，红热熔岩从断崖倾泻，地面裂缝一路向列车延伸。
列车沿熔岩峡谷高速穿行，火山弹从天空划过但不撞击车厢，一股灼热冲击波从后方追来。玻璃映出真实火光，车厢由金色逐渐变成强烈的红橙色，乘客紧握扶手、震惊望向窗外。保持真实重力、烟尘和火山碎屑运动。
19-22秒——时空下潜：
列车冲进由火山蒸汽、浓烟和白色水汽组成的巨大云墙，画面被自然覆盖但镜头始终没有中断。红色火光迅速转为幽蓝色，蒸汽凝结成水珠掠过玻璃。列车无缝穿越时空界面，进入深海；车厢内部始终干燥完整，没有海水渗入。
22-28秒——海底世界：
白色水汽散开，窗外出现广阔、清澈、深邃的蓝色海洋。阳光光束从海面穿透，五彩珊瑚、海草、鱼群、海龟和蝠鲼从不同深度掠过，产生壮观视差。巨大的蓝鲸从列车上方缓缓游过，鲸腹几乎覆盖整面全景窗，尺度极其震撼。冷蓝色波纹光在车厢和乘客脸上自然流动，所有乘客安静仰望。
28-30秒——终极揭晓：
蓝鲸尾鳍掠过玻璃形成最后一次自然遮挡。尾鳍离开后，窗外豁然出现一座横跨海底峡谷的宏伟失落文明：发光的水晶高塔、巨型圆顶、古老神殿和悬浮轨道延伸到深海尽头，无数蝠鲼在城市上空穿行。列车继续驶向城市中央明亮的时空之门。
镜头保持车厢内的原始构图，在全体乘客震撼凝望的剪影中结束，不淡出，不切镜。
摄影机：
全程24mm电影广角，眼平高度，车厢后部斜向前方的固定三分构图；稳定器质感结合轻微列车震动；真实景深、玻璃反射、前景运动模糊和多层视差。摄影机绝不离开车厢，绝不改变轴线，绝不突然推拉、旋转或漂移。
声音：
持续而统一的列车轨道声作为声音锚点；隧道回声、恐龙低频脚步与咆哮、火山爆炸和熔岩轰鸣、蒸汽冲击声、进入深海后的低沉水下环境音、鲸鸣。声音随场景平滑过渡，电影级环绕声，无背景歌曲，无多余对白。
连续性约束：
同一列车、同一车厢、同一批乘客、同一服装、同一座位布局、同一玻璃窗结构、同一镜头位置贯穿30秒；场景只能通过列车前进、岩壁遮挡、烟雾、蒸汽、黑暗或大型生物经过完成连续转场。车厢不变形，乘客不瞬移，窗外生物绝不进入车厢。

[Monster Lock-In]
Figure 1 serves as the sole reference for the monster; strictly adhere to this design—no resets, no alterations. Maintain its slender, ground-hugging quadrupedal posture, extremely long forelimbs, massive claws, protruding bony ridges, slender tail, low-crouching elongated head, deeply cleft long snout, dense rows of fangs, cold white eyes, slippery dark brown (nearly black) skin, a surface resembling decaying fascia, and constantly dripping mucus. Its movements must resemble those of a high-level predator: low-crouching, slow, calculating, creeping, and capable of sudden bursts of speed. Do not transform it into a humanoid form, do not adopt an “Alien”-style design, and do not allow its appearance to drift. Multiple creatures of the same species may be lurking, but the main monster must be the clearest, most complete, and most oppressive.

Figure 2 serves as the sole reference for the female protagonist, named Alin; this is strictly locked in and must not be reset. 【Cinematography】
The cinematography should be sophisticated, restrained, and cinematic. Avoid random cuts, music video-style visuals, and exaggerated, shaky camera movements typical of action films. The overall feel should resemble the “death approaches” sequence in a high-tension thriller. Filming principles:
First, use a high-speed shot through the forest to establish danger,
then slow down as she enters the clearing,
followed by low-angle shots and alternating close-ups to establish mutual lock-on,
then circle around to reveal she is surrounded,
and finally, use extremely short, rapid cuts to bring the attack to its climax.
In the first half, it’s better to be a bit slower and more measured rather than rushing to scare the audience. Let the tension suddenly erupt in the final 0.5 seconds to create a jarring contrast.
[Second-by-Second Timeline]
0.0–2.8s
We race through the dense Amazon rainforest at FPV-like speeds. The camera sweeps past damp vines, moss-covered trunks, hanging branches and leaves, low-hanging mist, and massive, tangled roots. The pace is fast, but the space feels increasingly oppressive. Leaves, twigs, and shallow puddles are disturbed by the airflow. Occasionally, the blurry outline and cold, white eyes of the monster from Figure 1 flash by in the shadows of distant trees, but its full form must never be clearly visible. The only sound effects are the rustling of damp leaves, the low, guttural vocalizations of a distant creature, and the sporadic snapping of dry branches. The camera suddenly slows down at the end and comes to a stop at the edge of a dim clearing.
2.8–5.0s
Alin slowly steps out of the shadows and mist into the clearing, strictly maintaining the appearance shown in Figure 2. Her boots sink into black mud and decaying leaves, and the shallow water at her feet ripples gently. She isn’t running frantically; rather, as if she’s sensed something, she slowly comes to a halt and looks up toward the depths of the forest. A beam of Tyndall light filtering through a gap in the canopy falls upon her hair, shoulders, and half her face; her white top stands out starkly against the dim rainforest. Her breathing is light, her shoulders and back are tense, and her fingers are slightly clenched as she begins to realize she is no longer an observer, but the prey.
5.0–7.2s
The camera moves forward at a low angle, skimming the ground, peering through decaying leaves, black mud, and the crevices between tree roots toward the shadows ahead. The main monster slowly reveals half its body from behind a giant tree. First, its massive claws sink into the mud, pushing aside the black mud and decaying leaves; then, its slick bony spine and crouched head slowly emerge from the shadows. It does not pounce, but merely raises its head extremely slowly, its cold, white eyes glowing in the shadows as mucus drips silently from the corners of its mouth. The entire sequence should feel like a predator confirming its prey, not a sudden, startling leap.
7.2–9.5s
Cross-cutting close-ups establish “mutual sight.” A close-up of Alin’s face shows her pupils slightly constricted and her lips slightly parted, though she makes no sound; a close-up of the monster’s head shows its long snout slowly opening, revealing sharp fangs and stringy mucus; Alin gently shifts her stance with the tips of her boots, planting her heels more firmly; the monster’s forelimbs move half a step forward, the muscles in its shoulders, back, and limbs slowly tensing beneath its wet skin. The mist particles in the beam of light float motionless; time seems to stretch out. The emotion here is this: she hasn’t fled, and it hasn’t pounced yet, but the battle has already begun.
9.5–11.8s

As the camera moves, several other monsters of the same kind appear faintly among the shadows of the trees and vegetation in the background: some are crawling close to the ground, with only their eyes and front paws visible; others are crouching behind tree roots, their long snouts half-open; still others are merely silhouettes of their spines in the mist farther away. None of them charge out; they simply form a silent encirclement. The rustling in the woods grows denser; bird song in the distance ceases entirely, and the air seems to be taken over by a collective will.
11.8–13.4s
The main monster begins to close in for real. Extreme close-ups of its face, claws, and shoulder line. Its sharp claws dig deep into the mud, pushing aside decaying leaves as black water oozes from between them. Mucus drips from the corners of its mouth onto the mud, making a faint, wet sound. It tilted its head slightly, as if assessing which angle would make it easiest to snap its prey’s throat. 13.4–14.5s
A series of extremely brief, rapid cuts, the rhythm suddenly tightening: Alin’s eyes, the monster’s cold, white eyes, her boots gripping the mud, the monster’s hind legs lowering, its mouth opening just a little wider, a faint breath from her chest, the claws slowly exerting force in the mud, and the silhouettes of its companions simultaneously leaning forward slightly. 14.5–15.0s
In the final 0.5 seconds, the main monster suddenly erupts. It launches forward from a crouched, motionless position at blinding speed, its mouth wide open, slime and rows of teeth hurtling toward the camera and Alin’s face. The camera only has time to capture the afterimage of its forward momentum, its claws leaving the ground, and the split second Alin looks up to meet the attack. The scene cuts to black directly before the monster strikes her face and is about to bite.
[Sound Effects]
No music; only ambient and creature sounds. The rustling of damp leaves, a low guttural growl in the distance, the crunch of decaying leaves being crushed, the squelch of black mud, the rippling of shallow water, the dripping of slime, insects suddenly falling silent, and the monster’s wet breathing and the slimy sounds between its teeth at extremely close range. In the final 0.5 seconds as it lunges, the sound suddenly peaks: mud cracking under its feet, sharp claws cutting through the air, slime being flung, and the monster’s low growl as it attacks—but avoid explosive jump-scare sound effects.
【Negative Keywords】
Cartoonish, anime-style, chibi, low-poly, humanoid monsters, altered monster appearance, missing claws, incorrect mouth shapes, missing slime, dry skin, ordinary forests, sunny meadows, cities, ruins, blood splatter, low-quality jump scares, watermarks, text, UI, excessive or illogical shaking, clipping, cropping, blurriness, and inability to clearly see the monster’s structure.

title: Gladiator Arena Cinematic Test
prompt:

Global style: Ancient Roman Colosseum at golden hour. Real sand floor, worn and bloodstained. 50,000 people filling every tier. Afternoon sun cutting across at a low angle, long shadows and blinding lens flares. Bleach bypass color grade — crushed blacks, warm amber highlights, heavy film grain. Real, sweaty, brutal.
The gladiator: Late 20s, Mediterranean features, dark eyes, short dark hair. Lean but powerful. Battered bronze breastplate, torn leather arm wraps, a Roman gladius in his right hand. Dust and blood on his face. Exhausted but unbroken.
[0–4s] Camera dives from above the Colosseum down to ground level. Tilts up from his sandals to his face. Twelve opponents tighten their circle. Hard cut to his eyes — locked in.
[4–10s] Rapid cuts: spearman charges, gladiator steps inside, drives his elbow into the man’s face. Wide shot — he spins low, sword catching the sun. Two men charge simultaneously — he drops to one knee, they collide above him. Close-up: blood on his cheek, breathing hard.
[10–18s] Handheld gets in close — chaotic and immediate. Sparks off his breastplate, a helmet spinning into the sand, dust turning golden in the haze. Overhead shot showing the chaos from above. Crowd on their feet. He takes a shield bash to the chest, stumbles, spits blood. Raises the sword.
[18–24s] Two opponents remain. They circle. Tight close-ups — eyes, jaw, grip. Five seconds of near silence. Then he moves first. Two hard cuts. Both men hit the sand. The crowd erupts.
[24–28s] Cut to the Imperial box. The Emperor moves slowly from shadow into light. Cold eyes, absolute stillness. The crowd quiets. His hand rises.
[28–30s] Thumb up. The Colosseum detonates. Hard cut to the gladiator — he raises his sword toward the Emperor, arm trembling. Camera pulls back wide and fast. Freeze frame. Smash cut to black.

Her hair continues to flow in the wind, her immense red garment continues to ripple and breathe with natural weight, and she can move her hand through the frozen world. Rain droplets, leaves, bark fragments, twigs, mud particles and torn moss become perfectly suspended in the air. The environment freezes absolutely. Important: only the world freezes. 一张高完成度、真实摄影质感的中国年轻成年女性极近景美容肖像。人物视觉年龄约 20–26 岁，具有自然明确的中国女性特征，整体气质清纯、柔弱感、安静、湿润、带轻情绪与电影感，成年感明确，不幼态，不欧美化，不网红化，不复制任何参考人物的具体骨相，仅借鉴理想中的皮肤净度、眼睛明亮度、湿润妆感、近景镜头语言与柔光美容摄影氛围。
人物采用 B｜明眸电影脸。脸型与骨相为偏长鹅蛋脸，颧骨低调，面中柔和饱满，下颌纤秀但不过尖。整体保持真实合理的东方柔和骨相：额头自然饱满，太阳穴平滑，颧骨存在轻微支撑但不外扩，面中柔和丰润，脸颊细腻柔软，下颌线清晰纤秀但不锋利，下巴小巧精致但不过尖，脸部线条流畅自然，呈现具有电影女主感的中国年轻女性面部结构。
眼部设计为大杏眼略带下垂感，茶琥珀虹膜，下眼睑泪线更明确，角膜水膜感加强，双眼长条窗型高光。人物拥有偏大的明亮东方杏眼，横向舒展，纵向开合偏大但保持真人比例，眼尾略带自然下垂感，呈现温柔、脆弱、安静的眼神气质；双眼皮自然柔和，卧蚕清晰但不过分夸张。虹膜为通透的茶琥珀色，具有细密真实的放射状纹理、清晰的瞳孔边界与自然深棕外缘环，在正面柔光照射下带有轻微蜂蜜棕与琥珀棕层次。眼白明亮清澈但不死白，下眼睑泪线比常规近景更明确，角膜具有更强的湿润透明水膜感，内眼角轻微湿润。双眼均带有较大面积、横向延展的长条窗型高光，真正进入虹膜内部，使眼睛整体显得湿润、明亮、通透、有情绪、有生命力，成为整张肖像的第一视觉中心。
鼻唇设计为纤细自然鼻梁，小圆鼻尖，柔软微启唇，下唇水润饱满。鼻根自然，鼻梁细秀顺直但不过分刀削，鼻尖小巧圆润，鼻翼收敛且保留真实结构；嘴唇自然柔软，微微张开，唇峰温和，下唇更具水润饱满感，保留轻微真实唇纹，呈现细腻柔润、轻微水光但不过分玻璃化的真实唇部质感。
皮肤采用冷白水瓷低频肌，皮肤水润但不油亮。肤色为高明度、低饱和、中性偏冷的冷白水瓷基底，整体白净、纯净、柔和、通透，明显降低黄调、灰调、土色感与肉粉感。大面积面颊、额头与下巴保持低频、平整、安静、细腻的皮肤表面，几乎看不到明显毛孔、粗糙颗粒和高频皮肤噪声。皮肤真实感不依赖大面积毛孔，而通过自然面部结构、连续明暗过渡、皮下透光，以及鼻翼、眼周与唇周极轻微真实微结构来体现。整体带有轻柔水润感，但绝不油亮、绝不厚重反光、绝不塑料。脸部大面积保持冷净瓷白，仅在眼下、眼周、苹果肌中心小范围、鼻尖和嘴唇保留极低浓度的淡粉血色，形成“白是主体、粉是点缀”的色彩关系。额头、鼻梁、苹果肌与唇峰带有宽而柔和的微水光，皮肤显得白净、细腻、湿润、通透，但绝不蜡像、绝不 CG 化。
妆容采用极淡玫粉湿润妆，眼下粉色稍明显，唇部淡玫瑰裸粉。眼周使用极淡玫粉、灰粉玫瑰色与轻柔裸粉进行低浓度晕染，上下眼睑之间有柔和的粉润呼应，眼下粉色气息比普通清透妆稍明显，但仍保持克制和自然；眼尾仅以极细自然眼线轻微修饰。睫毛为黑褐色或深棕黑，纤长、根根分明、自然卷翘，密度适中，不夸张不厚重。腮红轻柔集中在眼下与苹果肌中心小范围，呈现若有若无的湿润气色。嘴唇采用淡玫瑰裸粉色，低饱和、柔润、轻反光、保留真实细唇纹，传达含蓄、安静、轻情绪的电影感。
发型为黑色柔顺长发，发根自然，中分，几缕略带湿润感的细碎发贴近脸侧。头发整体柔顺自然，发丝保留真人摄影质感与适量高频细节，单根发丝自然可辨，不出现塑料发丝、假发感和 CG 边缘；几缕靠近脸侧的细碎发带有若有若无的湿润贴肤感，增强雨后般的脆弱、柔软与情绪氛围，但整体造型仍然干净克制，不凌乱，不脏。
摄影采用 105mm 极近景，正面面向镜头，低饱和蓝灰背景。使用 105mm 长焦美容人像镜头语言，避免广角透视畸变。人物脸部占据画面约 70%–90%，正面直视镜头，双眼位于视觉中心偏上区域。焦点优先锁定双眼、虹膜与睫毛，嘴唇次清晰，耳部和后侧头发可轻微虚化。画面整体遵循“低频皮肤 + 高频五官”的摄影原则：皮肤大面积区域局部反差较低，睫毛、虹膜、瞳孔、泪线、唇纹与发丝保持较高真实度与清晰度。
光线采用高调正面美容柔光系统：一个超大面积柔光源位于摄影机正前方、略高于人物眼睛并靠近人物，柔和向下照射，同时存在低强度柔和补光，使人物面部整体明亮均匀，眼窝、鼻翼、眼下与下颌阴影非常浅且干净。皮肤高光宽而柔和，白净通透但不死白过曝，阴影保持中性或轻微冷调，不发黄、不发灰绿、不发脏。背景采用低饱和蓝灰色，亮度低于人物脸部约半档到一档，保持高度简洁和弱化，以衬托人物肤色更显白净、清冷、湿润、纯净。

title: Coastal Pavilion Construction Timelapse
prompt:
生成一条约10秒、9:16竖屏、超写实建筑施工压缩延时短片。
场景位于崎岖的黑色玄武岩海岸，周围是灰蓝色海水，海平线位于画面上三分之一附近。采用高位三分之四俯拍，建筑始终位于画面中下部。
全片必须保持同一栋紧凑型单层矩形海岸亭屋：固定长宽比例，厚重的平挑檐屋顶，屋顶中央只有一个规则方形开口，四角为深炭灰钢柱，正面和右侧为黑色细框落地玻璃，左侧为一整面不规则灰色玄武岩石墙，浅灰混凝土平台、窄环绕步道和细黑金属栏杆。施工过程中不得改变建筑层数、朝向、屋顶轮廓、开口位置、柱网和石墙与玻璃墙的关系。
0.00–1.38秒：
冷灰阴天下，一辆黄色履带式推土机在火山岩包围的矩形地块内快速往返，铲刀持续接触地面并平整泥土，扬起短促、自然的尘雾。高位镜头基本锁定，只有极轻微稳定漂移。
硬切。
1.38–2.71秒：
混凝土搅拌车通过溜槽向方形模板和钢筋网内浇筑湿混凝土，混凝土从中心向四周扩散。佩戴安全帽和反光背心的工人用长柄工具快速摊平地基。模板、车辆和海岸环境保持稳定。
硬切。
2.71–5.25秒：
在同一块基础上进行高速但清晰可读的钢结构施工。构件按照“柱脚、竖向钢柱、外圈梁、屋顶网格、黑框玻璃、屋面板”的顺序安装。吊钩从画面上方垂下，钢构件只在合理的结构连接点就位。厚平屋顶逐块完成，同时始终保留中央方形屋顶开口。天空从冷灰色逐渐转为柔和暖橙色，具有轻微AI生长式时间压缩感，但建筑几何保持坚硬、稳定。
硬切。
5.25–6.21秒：
切换到较近的侧立面中景。工人从墙体底部向上逐排安装不规则灰色玄武岩石块，同时完成浅灰地面铺装、玻璃门窗和立面收口。石材只能出现在指定实体墙区域，不得覆盖玻璃。镜头只有轻微稳定漂移。
硬切。
6.21–10.04秒：
切换到完成态建筑外侧视角。施工人员和设备快速清场，暖黄色室内灯、石墙壁灯和小型步道灯依次点亮。镜头平稳向后退并缓慢升高，逐渐揭晓完整的现代亭屋、黑色火山岩、近岸海浪、远处海湾和橙粉色晚霞。玻璃轻微反射暮色，粗糙石墙和湿润岩石细节清晰，海水缓慢流动。片尾摄影机仍处于轻柔后退升高状态，自然截停，不淡出、不定格。
整体呈现超写实建筑可视化、治愈系海岸氛围和受控的AI施工延时质感。材料真实、光影克制、空间关系稳定。五个镜头之间只使用直接硬切，不使用叠化、闪白或变形转场。无字幕、无Logo、无界面元素、无水印。

title: Cold Altitude Environment Test
prompt:
A cinematic travel montage of a solitary young female hiker exploring vast dramatic natural landscapes. Photorealistic, ultra-high detail, filmic color science, anamorphic lens feel, subtle film grain, rich natural contrast. Exact same cinematography as the reference: contemplative wide frames, slow deliberate camera moves, epic scale that dwarfs the human figure, seamless ground-to-aerial transitions, dramatic weather and light changes.
Consistent subject
Young East-Asian woman, mid-20s, long straight dark hair, slender athletic build. Cream-white knit beanie → white bucket hat; light sage-grey technical rain jacket → white softshell hoodie; dark olive-green hiking backpack with red zipper accents; black hiking pants; trekking poles. Calm, solitary presence — never looks at camera, always absorbed in the landscape.
Shot-by-shot timeline (exact pacing & camera language)
0.0–1.8s  
Wide static-to-slow push-in. Woman sitting on mossy green highland plateau, back to camera, hands resting on the grass, white beanie, sage jacket, dark backpack. Vast turquoise lake dotted with small rounded islands under heavy layered cloudy sky with soft blue openings. Soft overcast daylight, cool teal-green color grade. Gentle breeze moves her hair. Camera slowly creeps forward and slightly rises, emphasizing solitude and scale.
1.8–3.1s  
Tracking shot from behind at medium-wide. She walks steadily uphill across rolling emerald hills, trekking pole in right hand, white beanie, same backpack. A vivid double rainbow arcs across the grey-green sky over distant soft mountains. Slight handheld micro-sway, camera following at her walking pace, low and slightly behind.
3.1–4.2s
Static wide shot. She stands alone on a small grassy spit at the edge of a dark alpine lake, facing away, white hoodie, yellow-tinged beanie. Towering jagged black peaks rise steeply, low white clouds and mist clinging to the rock faces. Moody, desaturated blue-grey light. Still water reflects the mountains. Pure contemplative silence.
4.2–5.9s  
Slow aerial drone pull-back and slight orbit. High-angle reveal of the same dark lake from above — perfect circular dark water, dense conifer forest, tiny red-roofed building at the shore, dramatic mist-shrouded granite spires and snow patches. Low clouds pour over the ridges like a waterfall. Cool high-contrast desaturated grade. Smooth floating drone motion.
5.9–7.8s  
Night sequence. Extreme wide. Black SUV with glowing red taillights drives slowly left-to-right on a flat dark lakeshore road. Massive violet-pink lightning bolt cracks across the deep indigo sky, illuminating distant mountains and water for a fraction of a second. Camera holds wide and static. Residual thin lightning forks linger after the flash.
7.8–9s  
Golden-hour peak shot. Woman stands on a grassy ridgeline, white bucket hat, backpack, one trekking pole, looking left toward the horizon. Endless layered mountain ranges fade into soft atmospheric haze under glowing orange-pink sunrise/sunset. Soft rim light on her silhouette. Slow subtle push-in.
9–11.6s 
Epic aerial tracking shot. Smooth high-speed drone follows a black SUV driving along a winding dirt mountain road through lush green karst-like hills. Multiple white wind turbines on ridges. Deep valleys with patchwork green fields, distant lake and town. Brilliant clear blue sky with scattered white cumulus. Camera flies parallel and slightly above the road, car becomes a tiny moving element.
11.60–14s  
Intimate POV from inside a car (slightly soft foreground of A-pillar and side mirror). Through the open window we see the same woman standing outside on the overlook, white bucket hat, green backpack, holding binoculars to her eyes, gazing at the vast green mountain range and wind turbines under late-afternoon light. Soft focus on car interior, sharp on her and the landscape. Gentle breeze moves her hair.
Overall cinematography & technical notes
Camera language: locked-off contemplative wides, slow creeping push-ins, organic tracking, floating drone reveals, one intimate car-POV. Never shaky.  
Lighting progression: soft overcast → dramatic rainbow → cold misty alpine → night lightning → golden hour → crisp clear daylight.  
Color science: cool teal-greens and greys early, warm golden tones mid-way, rich emerald and deep blue later. Subtle anamorphic flare and gentle film grain.  
Mood: quiet awe, solitude, the scale of nature vs one small human traveler. 24 fps cinematic motion, 4K detail.

title: Realism Defense 30s Test
prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary day in the life of a young Korean man. No reference image.
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean man in his early 20s, naturally attractive, realistic skin texture, minimal grooming, relaxed and slightly sleepy expression.
Medium-length naturally messy black hair, subtle stubble, a few loose strands falling across his forehead.
Wearing an oversized faded charcoal T-shirt, loose olive trousers, worn sneakers, and a simple silver watch.
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video.
SETTING
A quiet older residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon.
Small apartment buildings, narrow concrete alleys, rooftop terraces, neighborhood laundries, corner shops, parked bicycles, potted plants, utility wires, concrete staircases, trees providing patches of shade, and ordinary people going about their day.
Everything should feel lived-in and authentic.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend.
Handheld camera with natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional partial crops, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts between sunlight and shade, mild motion blur, soft image detail, subtle digital noise, slightly faded colors, and natural camera imperfections.
The camera operator walks with him and reacts naturally.
No stabilization, no cinematic camera movements, no dramatic lighting, no slow motion, no polished commercial appearance.
The footage should feel accidentally beautiful rather than deliberately cinematic.
⸻
00:00–00:05 — LEAVING HOME
He steps out of his apartment carrying a small reusable shopping bag.
He locks the door, checks his pockets for his keys and phone, then starts walking downstairs.
The camera follows behind him.
He briefly looks back at the camera and gives a sleepy half-smile.
⸻
00:05–00:10 — MORNING ERRAND
He walks through a quiet neighborhood alley toward a small local grocery shop.
He passes parked bicycles and people watering plants outside their homes.
He stops at a roadside fruit stand and picks up a couple of oranges, inspecting them casually before placing them into his bag.
The camera briefly focuses on the fruit before returning to his face.
⸻
00:10–00:15 — SMALL BREAK
He sits on a low concrete wall outside the shop.
He opens a cold bottled drink and takes a few sips.
A breeze moves his hair.
He watches people passing by without saying anything.
The camera stays slightly shaky and imperfectly framed, as if his friend is simply sitting nearby filming him.
⸻
00:15–00:20 — WALKING HOME
He gets up and continues walking.
A bicycle passes behind him.
He notices a stray cat sitting beside a wall, crouches down and gently pets it.
The cat walks away.
He laughs quietly and stands back up.
The camera operator accidentally cuts off part of his head while moving closer, then quickly reframes him.
⸻
00:20–00:25 — ROOFTOP
He returns home and walks onto a small rooftop.
He places the shopping bag beside an old chair.
He leans against the railing and looks across the neighborhood.
The afternoon sunlight falls naturally across his face.
He runs his hand through his messy hair and quietly watches the distant buildings.
⸻
00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT
He notices the camera still recording.
He looks directly into the lens and gives a tiny amused smile.
He casually says:
“You’re still recording?”
He shakes his head and walks toward the camera.
The camera moves backward slightly as he approaches.
The recording abruptly cuts to black before he reaches the camera.
⸻
AUDIO
Natural location sound only:
Footsteps, distant traffic, bicycles, birds, wind, neighborhood conversations, shop sounds, bottle opening, fabric movement, doors closing, and subtle handheld camera noise.
No music.
No narration.
No artificial sound effects.
Only the single spoken line: “You’re still recording?”
⸻
FINAL FEEL
The entire video should feel like a completely ordinary day that somehow became a beautiful memory.
Quiet, masculine, youthful, intimate, warm, slightly nostalgic, and spontaneous.
No dramatic events.
No exaggerated acting.
No model poses.
No cinematic hero shots.
The realism should come from tiny imperfections, casual body language, natural expressions, ordinary surroundings, imperfect camera operation, and moments that feel completely unplanned.

title: Peaceful Cinematic Moment Slow
prompt: A peaceful cinematic scene of a young woman sitting quietly on a wooden park bench surrounded by lush green ferns and dense tropical foliage. 夕阳下的摩天楼楼顶，两人相隔十五米对峙。强风掠过，青岚的绿色丝巾横向飞扬，夜璃缓缓压低重心。镜头贴着地面快速推进。
0.8–1.5秒：
青岚率先踏碎地面冲锋，脚下炸开碎石。夜璃身体化为一道紫黑色折线残光，瞬间消失。
1.5–2.5秒：
夜璃在青岚背后重新出现，一记高速回旋踢横扫头部；青岚仿佛提前预判，俯身闪过，同时向后打出肘击。夜璃抬膝精准挡住。
2.5–4秒：
两人贴身完成六次清晰的拳、肘、膝、掌攻防，最后同时击中对方格挡手臂。青绿与紫黑能量猛烈碰撞，环形冲击波扫过楼顶，将尘埃和碎石向外推开。
镜头：
24mm低机位冲刺跟拍，转入180度环绕；碰撞瞬间进行0.3秒升格，随后立刻恢复高速。
重点：
每一击都有明确起手、格挡、接触和回弹，不能只是快速挥舞手臂。
SHOT 2｜4–9秒：高空踏步追杀
4–5秒：
冲击波将夜璃震出楼顶边缘。她没有坠落，而是在空中翻身调整姿态。青岚冲到边缘纵身跃出。
5–6.5秒：
青岚连续七次踩踏空气向上追击。每一步脚底都压出清晰的白色空气圆环，伴随短促音爆，身体以锐利折线不断改变方向，如同踩着无形台阶冲向天空。
6.5–7.5秒：
夜璃紫光一闪，瞬移到青岚上方发动下劈腿。青岚在半空再次踏爆空气，身体横向急转，鞋尖擦着夜璃的攻击掠过。
7.5–9秒：
两人一边踏空移动，一边完成空中追逐攻防：夜璃连续瞬移至青岚左右两侧发动踢击，青岚以掌、肘和膝依次格挡。最后青岚抓住夜璃手腕，借旋转惯性将她甩向远处楼顶。
镜头：
长焦侧面追拍两人飞越城市峡谷，随后镜头从空气圆环中央穿过，翻转为高空俯拍。
重点：
踏空不是飞行，每次改变方向前必须先用脚主动踩出空气圆环；夜璃的瞬移必须拥有紫黑闪光、起点残影和清晰落点。
SHOT 3｜9–15秒：立体高速反杀
9–10秒：
夜璃即将撞上远处楼顶时突然瞬移消失。青岚独自悬在两栋楼之间，立刻警觉回头。
10–11.5秒：
夜璃连续进行三段空间跳跃：
第一次出现在青岚正上方，发动下劈；
第二次出现在青岚左侧，发动侧踢；
第三次出现在青岚背后，发动掌击。
青岚连续踏空闪避前两击，第三击用双臂交叉挡下。
11.5–13秒：
掌击冲击力将青岚轰向楼体。她在距离玻璃幕墙不到一米处猛踩空气，爆出巨大的青绿色圆环，瞬间停止倒飞，紧接着借反作用力高速反冲。
13–14秒：
青岚化为一道青色直线撞向夜璃。夜璃连续瞬移五次制造紫黑残影迷阵，六个身影从不同方向同时包围青岚。
14–15秒：
青岚闭眼感知，在真正的夜璃攻击前一瞬突然转身，精准抓住她的脚踝。所有虚假残影同时破碎成紫色光屑。青岚旋身将夜璃掷回主楼楼顶，自己紧随其后踏空俯冲。
镜头：
垂直俯冲、突然急停、绕人物高速旋转，但始终保持双方位置清楚。残影只用于表现速度，真实人物始终只有两位。
SHOT 4｜15–20秒：终极碰撞
15–16秒：
夜璃落地单手撑住楼顶，滑行数米后稳住。青岚从天空俯冲落地，两人相隔十米。落地冲击同时震起圆形尘浪。
16–17秒：
两人同时蓄力。
青岚沉肩收拳，青绿色能量沿手臂螺旋压缩。
夜璃抬起右腿，紫黑色能量凝聚成锋利弧光。
周围碎石受力量影响缓缓悬浮，空气出现轻微扭曲。
17–18.5秒：
两人同时踏碎地面冲向对方。夜璃在冲刺中短距离瞬移三次，攻击路线忽左忽右；青岚连续踩出三个贴近地面的空气圆环，每一步都让速度再次暴增。
18.5–19.3秒：
青岚的正拳与夜璃的旋身踢在画面中央正面相撞。镜头瞬间进入超慢动作：拳峰与鞋面之间先出现一颗被压缩到极致的双色能量球，随后轰然爆发。青绿与紫黑冲击波冲上天空，切开云层，整座楼顶出现放射状裂纹。
19.3–20秒：
强光散去，两人已经交换位置，背对彼此站立。青岚的绿色丝巾缓缓落下，夜璃的珍珠耳饰轻轻晃动。两人同时侧过脸，露出棋逢对手的锐利微笑。镜头高速拉远，展现夕阳、云海与被冲击波切开的巨大圆形云洞，硬切黑场。
【视听效果】
拳脚碰撞具有厚重低频、短促空气爆鸣和清晰衣料摩擦声。
踏空伴随空气压缩、圆环爆开和连续音爆。
瞬移伴随干脆的空间撕裂声，不使用拖沓魔法音效。
最终碰撞前瞬间完全静音，爆发时恢复巨大冲击声与城市回响。
无对白、无人声歌词、无字幕。
【生成约束】
真人电影级皮肤和布料质感；高速动作仍能看清人物面容与攻防关系；镜头运动强烈但不混乱；双方受击具有重量、惯性和回弹；超能力轨迹简洁锐利，不遮挡角色。
Negative：
雨天，雨水，湿发，湿衣服，积水，潮湿地面，阴沉暴雨，面容变化，换脸，角色互换，年龄变化，发型漂移，服装变化，丝巾消失，耳饰消失，身材比例变化，额外人物，人物复制，多余肢体，多余手指，手脚融合，关节反折，穿模，布偶动作，无重量感攻击，拳脚没有接触，攻击穿过身体，随意漂浮，普通飞行，踏空动作模糊，空气圆环位置错误，瞬移没有起点或落点，无法分辨的混乱残影，随机爆炸，能量遮挡脸部，过量粒子，镜头无意义抖动，空间方向混乱，突然切换场景，卡通渲染，塑料CG皮肤，低清晰度，过曝，血液，伤口，骨折，猎奇暴力，身体部位特写，色情化运镜，文字，字幕，水印，Logo。

title: Zombie Post Apocalypse Combat
prompt:
Hyper-realistic post-apocalyptic urban settings with high-speed, violent combat scenes; cinematic-quality live-action VFX; IMAX-level action movie aesthetics; ARRI 35mm anamorphic look; 8K hyper-realism; realistic motion blur; and authentic physical simulations of dust, shattered glass, metal debris, fabric, hair, bloodstains, and shrapnel. No animated look, no video game CG aesthetic, no cartoonish style, and no low-quality superpower effects. The overall vibe is: a dark massacre in the ruins of daylight—high-speed, brutal, cold-blooded, and overwhelmingly violent.
[Main Character Locked]
Use the character in Image 1 as the sole reference for the main character; lock it in immediately and do not reset. Strictly maintain consistency in her face, long straight light-blonde hair, cold expression, white sleeveless top, blue jeans, brown knee-high boots, body proportions, and overall demeanor. She is not an armored warrior, but a high-speed shadow hunter in a post-apocalyptic city. Keep her appearance exactly as shown in Figure 1; only grant her the ability to teleport at extreme speeds as a shadow. Her fighting style is extremely calm, ruthless, and devoid of unnecessary movements; she specializes in inflicting maximum damage via the shortest possible path.
【Scene Lock】
Use the scene in Figure 2 as the sole environmental reference; lock it directly without resetting. A large, post-apocalyptic urban ruin district with wide streets flanked by crumbling, dilapidated high-rises. Abandoned vehicles are scattered about, and the road surface is covered with dust, cracks, metal shards, trash, stagnant water, and broken glass. Cold daylight filters through the skyscrapers, creating a pale main light source; shadows are deep, and the air is filled with dust, haze, and floating particles, with the wind stirring paper scraps and fine dust. The environment must retain the open, ruined feel of Figure 2; it must not resemble a warehouse or a night scene.
【Enemy Design】
Enemies consist of 6 to 10 infected individuals / zombified thugs. They should have realistic human anatomy, with tattered clothing, ashen skin, hungry eyes, and frenzied movements. They run fast and attack ferociously, resembling predators in a post-apocalyptic world. They must not be sluggish or resemble comical zombies. Some enemies may have minor fractures and dislocations, bloodstained scratch marks, or twisted joints, but overall they should remain realistic infected humans—not alien monsters.
【Abilities and Visual Effects Principles】
Retain shadow teleportation, but visual effects must be restrained yet sophisticated:
Black smoke vortexes, rapid bursts of shadows, brief trails of black fragments, slight distortions as if tearing through the air, and afterimages that linger for half a second before fading.
No magic circles, no lasers, no magical explosions, and no wide-area shockwaves. The focus is on “the protagonist being too fast, too ruthless, and too deadly.”
【Shot Style】
Focus primarily on continuous, cinematic long takes, supplemented by a very small number of brief, violent cuts. Shots should feature smooth tracking, rapid turns, close-up circling, and re-framing the protagonist after teleportation. All shots must serve the clarity of the fight sequences. Close-ups should focus on the moment of impact; medium shots should clearly show the sequence of movements; wide shots should illustrate how the protagonist instantly reshapes the battlefield. A small number of extremely brief slow-motion sequences are permitted to emphasize broken bones, punches and kicks landing, and enemies being sent flying, but the overall tone remains one of ultra-high-speed domination. The camerawork must make the audience feel that “the protagonist is faster than the camera itself.”
[Battle Structure]
Opening: The protagonist stands alone in the center of the ruined neighborhood shown in Figure 2, as the wind stirs up dust and scraps of paper. From behind the shadows of wrecked cars, through gaps in the building walls, and amid the debris lining the streets, infected creatures surge forth one after another, swarming toward her like a pack of predators.
First Strike: Just as the first infected is about to reach her face, she vanishes from where she stands. Only a cluster of exploding black shadow fragments remains on the ground. In the next frame, she appears behind the enemy and delivers a straight punch so powerful it seems almost inhuman, striking the back of the head and neck. The enemy’s entire body bends into an unnatural arc as it flies through the air, smashing through the glass of a wrecked car, denting the door, and sending shards flying in all directions.
A Killing Spree: Before the first enemy had even hit the ground, she vanished again. She flashed across the street like a shadow of lightning, leaving afterimages in the air that traced the path she had just taken. She appeared behind, above, and to the sides of her enemies, finishing them off with the swiftest and most brutal close-quarters strikes: a point-blank elbow strike shattering a jaw, a knee strike snapping ribs, a spinning side kick sending a target tumbling down the entire street, grabbing an enemy by the head and slamming them into a car roof, and a heavy punch upon landing that smashed the enemy’s face into the ground.
The violence escalates: the camera captures the infected’s bodies repeatedly crashing into their surroundings—shattering lampposts, smashing through windshields, flipping over hoods, rolling into rubble and scrap metal, and causing car windows and doors to burst and warp with a deafening crash. Every time she reappears after a teleport, the protagonist is shrouded in a black mist; she isn’t merely fighting—she’s carrying out a precise slaughter.
Mid-Sequence Highlight: An infected leapt at her from the car roof; she instantly darted into the air to evade him, spun mid-air, and delivered a vicious kick that sent him crashing into the crumbling wall of a nearby building, sending plaster, broken bricks, and glass flying. She landed with almost no pause, vanishing immediately—the next frame showed her already on another enemy’s chest, delivering a piercing punch that sent him flying into the middle of the street, where he tumbled.
Brutal Close Combat: Include several extremely brief, violent close-ups—the instantaneous deformation of flesh and spatter of blood when a fist strikes a cheek; the sense of impact as a boot sole strikes the abdomen; a palm gripping a skull and slamming the enemy violently against a car window; teeth and blood spattering through the air after an elbow strike. Note: Maintain cinematic restraint—avoid cheap blood fountains.
Peak Speed: The remaining infected attempt to pounce simultaneously from different directions. The protagonist pauses for half a second—as if the air around her has been sucked out—then flashes through the shadows three times in rapid succession, leaving three black trails in different directions. Almost simultaneously, the three infected are sent flying in separate directions: one crashes through the side door of a wrecked car, one slams face-first into the cracked asphalt, and one is kicked high onto the car’s roof before tumbling off.
Final Segment: The last Infested, the one closest to her, charges forward with a growl. She doesn’t dodge but walks straight toward it. At point-blank range, she suddenly teleports half a step to its rear, grabs its head with one hand, and slams it backward into the car’s hood. The metal dents, and blood and dust explode outward. The enemy goes completely limp.
Closing Shot: The camera pulls back to reveal the entire street littered with infected creatures—knocked flying, twisted, and rolling among wrecked cars and debris. The protagonist stands in the center of the rubble, her chest rising and falling slightly. Her white shirt and hair are stained with dust, blood spatter, and lingering black shadows. title: Thread To World Logo Animation
prompt:
Create an epic fantasy title sequence built around a vast living tapestry. The sequence must feel like an entire world is being born from a single thread.
Begin in near darkness. Only the faint texture of woven fabric is visible. At the very center, one lone thread awakens. It trembles, pulls tight, glows faintly, and begins moving across the surface like a living force. As it races forward, it splits into more threads. Those threads split again, multiplying rapidly into branching strands of gold, crimson, ivory, midnight blue, and ash-gray. Everything in the sequence must originate from this first thread and its descendants. The world should feel as if it is being generated from one living source.
The camera moves dynamically and continuously through the tapestry, never static. It races low across the woven surface, whips past rising embroidered forms, glides along rivers made of flowing thread, dives through deep folds and valleys of cloth, and sweeps between giant raised textile structures. The camera must always remain on the exposed upper surface of the tapestry. It may skim across folds and pass through openings between raised embroidered forms, but it must never travel beneath the fabric.
The world should not simply appear. It must actively weave itself into existence in real time. At every moment, visible threads must remain in motion, constantly splitting, branching, knotting, braiding, tightening, and constructing new terrain, landmarks, symbols, and regions ahead of the camera. The world must never feel complete until the final logo reveal. The strongest visual rule is this: if something appears, it should be because threads are physically making it.
Cities, kingdoms, and landmarks must all be built through textile transformation. Threads knot together into towers, fortresses, ceremonial structures, bridges, and gates. Layers of cloth fold upward into cliffs, walls, and ridges. Roads are sewn rapidly across the land. Banners unfurl from the weave. Forests spread outward stitch by stitch as fibers become roots, trunks, branches, and canopies. Rivers are pulled into place by shimmering strands. Coastlines tighten into shape like stretched cloth under tension. Nothing should materialize passively. Everything must be woven, stitched, tied, pulled, or braided into existence by moving thread.
Each major region should feel like its own construction event. In one kingdom, royal motifs and heraldic embroidery bloom outward in ornate patterns. In another, scorched threads blacken and curl as if marked by war. In a frozen region, pale threads crystallize into icy stitched structures. In a desert realm, sand-colored silk folds into dunes and radiant sun motifs. In a battlefield region, red threads race violently across the surface like spreading conflict. In every case, the region should be visibly built by thread activity, not simply revealed.
Use aggressive but elegant camera choreography: fast push-ins, sweeping arcs, sharp climbs, dramatic pull-backs, overhead reveals, and low-angle passes through giant stitched landmarks and dense moving fibers. Let the camera chase the leading edge of construction. Often follow one strand as it races into empty fabric and begins creating the next formation. The camera should feel as if it is surfing the growth of the world itself.
The tapestry should feel handcrafted, ancient, ceremonial, and mythic. Show rich textile detail everywhere: layered cloth, frayed edges, gold thread, dense embroidery, woven symbols, stitched heraldry, seams, folds, braided cords, hanging fibers, and visible tension in the fabric. If desired, briefly glimpse looms, spools, or unseen weaving forces at the edges of the frame, but keep the main focus on the living tapestry and its self-weaving world.
The pacing should escalate constantly. Start with the mystery of one awakened thread. Then let that thread multiply into many. Then let those many threads begin forming entire regions. Then let multiple regions awaken at once as long strands travel across the tapestry and connect distant kingdoms, roads, battles, and symbols. The sequence should feel as if history, bloodlines, war, and power are all being woven from one original source.
Lighting should be dramatic and cinematic, with warm highlights skimming across thread textures, deep shadows in folds of cloth, soft glow passing through thin fabric, and floating dust in the air. The tone should feel majestic, ancient, noble, immersive, and alive.
Toward the climax, reveal that all kingdoms, roads, battles, and symbols are interconnected through one vast woven design. Long threads travel across the entire tapestry and begin drawing everything toward a central point. Regional patterns, sigils, and story elements align into one unified composition.
If a logo reference image is supplied, use that logo as the exact design authority for the ending. Preserve its silhouette, proportions, and core graphic structure. Do not simply reveal, overlay, or fade in the logo. Instead, the final logo must be physically built in real time from the same thread lineage that created the world. The first awakened thread and all the threads that descended from it should ultimately converge and construct the final emblem. Kingdoms, roads, rivers, banners, heraldic motifs, and regional patterns must unravel back into fibers and feed the final construction. Braided cords define the main silhouette. Dense embroidery fills the interior forms. Fine metallic threads complete the small details. The final logo should feel as if the whole world has transformed into it.
If no logo reference image is supplied, end with an original fantasy crest or title emblem emerging through the same thread-construction logic.
End with the completed logo fully stitched into the tapestry as a monumental embroidered insignia. The surrounding lands continue to ripple subtly with life as a few final strands glide into place, tighten, and lock the design.
Tone: majestic, ancient, dramatic, elegant, immersive, ceremonial, and alive.
Style keywords: living tapestry, single-origin thread, embroidered fantasy world, woven kingdoms, dynamic textile transformation, cinematic title sequence, mythic handcrafted world-building, epic camera motion.

title: Korea Nineteen Fifties Daily Life
prompt:
Create a highly realistic 30-second cinematic historical sequence set in Korea during the 1950s. The entire video should feel like a naturally observed fragment of ordinary life from that era — not a vlog, not a modern recording, and not a person performing for a camera.
MAIN SUBJECT:
A young Korean woman in her early 20s with a consistent, natural appearance and believable facial features. She has black hair tied loosely back, minimal makeup, natural skin texture and subtle everyday expressions.
Her outfit is period-inspired but youthful and attractive: a fitted cropped short-sleeve cotton top paired with high-waisted shorts ending around the upper thigh, simple flat leather shoes, and a small understated necklace. The clothing should look like authentic, practical 1950s cotton clothing rather than modern fashion. Natural fabric wrinkles, slightly faded colors and realistic stitching.
CONCEPT:
Show several small moments from her ordinary daily routine, progressing naturally from inside her home to the neighborhood outside. She never looks into or acknowledges the camera. There is no visible camera, filming equipment, phone or modern recording device.
SCENE 1 — MORNING AT HOME | 0–6 SEC
Inside a modest 1950s Korean home with wooden floors, simple bedding, handmade household objects and sunlight entering through a paper-covered window.
The woman folds a small stack of freshly washed clothes, then carries them outside in a woven basket. Her movements are casual and unhurried. Sunlight falls naturally across the room, revealing dust particles in the air.
SCENE 2 — HANGING LAUNDRY | 6–11 SEC
She steps into a small courtyard behind the house and hangs clothes on a simple rope line.
Show her stretching upward to place a shirt over the line, securing it with simple wooden clothespins, then smoothing another garment with her hands. A light breeze gently moves the hanging clothes and her loose hair.
Include small environmental details: clay pots, wooden walls, stone ground, a water basin and neighboring rooftops in the background.
SCENE 3 — PREPARING TO GO OUT | 11–16 SEC
She returns inside and quickly prepares to leave. She picks up a small woven shoulder bag, checks herself naturally in a small old-fashioned mirror, adjusts her hair and puts on her simple shoes.
Her expression is relaxed and spontaneous — never posed.
SCENE 4 — WALKING THROUGH THE NEIGHBORHOOD | 16–22 SEC
She walks out through a wooden gate into a quiet 1950s Korean residential lane.
Show traditional houses, stone walls, bicycles, wooden carts, laundry lines, children playing farther away and neighbors performing ordinary chores. She walks naturally through the scene carrying her small bag.
SCENE 5 — EVERYDAY ERRAND | 22–27 SEC
She approaches a small public water pump or communal washing area. She briefly fills a small metal container, adjusts her grip and continues walking.
Keep the interaction simple and believable. No vendor, no market performance and no staged interaction.
SCENE 6 — FINAL MOMENT | 27–30 SEC
She walks along a sunlit lane bordered by old Korean houses and trees. A breeze moves her clothes naturally as she passes through patches of sunlight and shadow.
She briefly pauses to look toward something happening farther down the street, smiles subtly, then continues walking out of frame.
VISUAL STYLE:
Authentic 1950s Korean period-film aesthetic. Photorealistic historical reconstruction with soft natural daylight, slightly faded monochrome or extremely subtle muted color, fine analog film grain, gentle halation, slight lens softness, natural exposure fluctuations and occasional tiny imperfections characteristic of period film.
The image must NOT look like a modern video with a generic "vintage filter." Architecture, clothing, props, materials and human behavior should all convincingly belong to 1950s Korea.
CAMERA:
Observational period cinematography. The camera exists as an unseen observer rather than a participant. Use carefully composed static shots mixed with very slow natural camera movement. No handheld vlog movement, no selfie perspective, no modern stabilization, no dramatic zooms and no shots where the subject appears aware of being filmed.
AUDIO:
Pure environmental sound: birds, distant voices, footsteps, fabric moving in the breeze, wooden doors, water flowing from the pump, distant bicycles and neighborhood activity. No music, no narration, no modern sound effects.
REALISM:
Every movement must obey real-world physics. Natural hands and fingers, realistic walking, believable fabric deformation, consistent shadows, physically accurate sunlight, authentic facial expressions and continuous character identity. No extra fingers, warped hands, floating objects, distorted faces, modern objects or AI-looking motion.
The final result should feel like a genuine 30-second fragment of everyday Korean life from the 1950s — intimate, quiet, observational and historically believable, with the woman's ordinary routine providing the visual story.
FORMAT:
30 seconds, Seedance 2.5, 16:9, ultra-high-quality photorealism, cinematic historical realism, consistent character identity, coherent transitions, natural motion and authentic 1950s Korean atmosphere.

Narrow residential streets, low concrete houses, small local shops, parked bicycles and scooters, utility poles, faded signs, leafy trees, pedestrians in the distance and authentic Korean street details. title: Extreme Mountain Biking Cuts
prompt:
Create an explosive, high-adrenaline extreme mountain-biking action sequence in 16:9, 24fps, exactly 30 distinct cuts, total runtime 30–31 seconds.
A lone rider in a dark grey/black hooded jacket, black shorts, gloves, backpack and full-face helmet rides a blue full-suspension mountain bike through a vast alpine landscape of steep rocky slopes, snow patches, green pine trees, dirt trails and distant snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky. Preserve the exact rider silhouette, bike color, clothing details, helmet design and environment throughout — never redesign them.
This film is 80 % pure kinetic camera motion and 20 % environmental drama: aggressive tracking shots, whip pans, snap zooms, speed ramps, motion blur, dust and snow particle bursts, rim-light flares and impact shakes. No text, no graphics, no logos — pure cinematic action.
### CUT LIST
CUT 01 | 0.00–1.00s
Low rear tracking shot: rider pedals hard away from camera on a narrow dirt trail cutting through green alpine meadow, snow patches and scattered pines; camera follows low and tight, slight motion blur on the ground.
CUT 02 | 1.00–2.00s
Camera rises slightly and accelerates; rider leans into a gentle left curve, mountains rising dramatically on both sides; speed lines of blurred grass and dirt.
CUT 03 | 2.00–3.00s 
Rider powers up a short incline then drops onto a steeper rocky section; camera stays locked behind, slight Dutch tilt as the trail narrows.
CUT 04 | 3.00–4.00s
Fast forward tracking over uneven dirt and snow; rider’s body pumps the bike, backpack shifting; distant peaks fill the upper frame.
CUT 05 | 4.00–5.00s
Rider approaches a sharp crest; camera drops lower, almost ground-level, dust kicking up from the rear tire.
**CUT 06 | 5.00–6.00s**  
Explosive launch: rider and bike leave the ground in a high backflip / inverted aerial over a rocky drop; camera tilts upward to follow the full rotation against the blue sky and mountain backdrop.
**CUT 07 | 6.00–7.00s**  
Rider lands hard on a steep rocky face and immediately accelerates downhill; camera recovers with a quick snap-zoom and impact shake.
**CUT 08 | 7.00–8.00s**  
Steep rocky descent; rider stays low and centered, bike suspension compressing; camera tracks tightly from behind with heavy motion blur on the rock surface.
**CUT 09 | 8.00–9.00s**  
Rider leans into a high-speed left turn on a near-vertical rock slab; camera swings wide then snaps back.
**CUT 10 | 9.00–10.00s**  
Another massive drop: rider launches off a cliff edge, arms outstretched, bike inverted above; camera freefalls with them, looking straight down into the deep valley below.
**CUT 11 | 10.00–11.00s**  
Mid-air recovery; rider rights the bike and falls toward a steep rock face; camera rotates with the motion.
**CUT 12 | 11.00–12.00s**  
Rider lands on the near-vertical face and begins a controlled high-speed descent; camera stays directly behind and slightly above.
**CUT 13 | 12.00–13.00s**  
Extreme angle looking almost straight down the cliff; rider is a small silhouette against the massive rock wall and distant valley floor.
**CUT 14 | 13.00–14.00s**  
Rider continues the steep descent, body low, bike tracking the rock contours; camera follows with continuous slight shake.
**CUT 15 | 14.00–15.00s**  
Slight pull-back revealing the full scale of the mountain face and the valley far below; rider remains centered.
**CUT 16 | 15.00–16.00s**  
Rider cuts across a diagonal rock ledge; camera banks hard with the movement.
**CUT 17 | 16.00–17.00s**  
High-speed traverse on a narrow rock spine; dust and small rocks kick up behind the tires.
**CUT 18 | 17.00–18.00s**  
Rider drops into a steeper chute; camera drops with them, heavy motion blur.
**CUT 19 | 18.00–19.00s**  
Rider emerges onto a broader rocky slope and accelerates; camera rises slightly for a wider view of the terrain.
**CUT 20 | 19.00–20.00s**  
Fast tracking across open rock and snow patches; rider stays low and aerodynamic.
**CUT 21 | 20.00–21.00s**  
Rider approaches another crest; camera drops low again, almost scraping the rock.
**CUT 22 | 21.00–22.00s**  
Rider launches a smaller jump, body compressed; camera follows the arc.
**CUT 23 | 22.00–23.00s**  
Landing and immediate acceleration down a smoother but still steep face; camera locks in tight rear tracking.
**CUT 24 | 23.00–24.00s**  
Rider carves a wide arc across the slope; distant snow fields and trees become visible lower in the frame.
**CUT 25 | 24.00–25.00s**  
High-speed section on a more open rocky plain; camera pulls back slightly to show the full landscape.
**CUT 26 | 25.00–26.00s**  
Rider approaches the final steep drop-off; camera lowers and accelerates.
**CUT 27 | 26.00–27.00s**  
Rider launches off the last major lip into a big aerial; camera freefalls with them.
**CUT 28 | 27.00–28.00s**  
Mid-air inversion / style grab; rider and bike silhouetted against the bright sky and distant peaks.
**CUT 29 | 28.00–29.00s**  
Rider lands on a grassy, snow-patched slope and immediately pedals hard toward a denser tree line; camera recovers with impact shake and continues tracking.
**CUT 30 | 29.00–30.73s**  
Final high-speed tracking shot as the rider disappears into the greener lower slope; camera gradually rises and the frame slowly overexposes to bright alpine light.
### Editing & Sound  
Extremely aggressive rhythm — hard cuts on every major terrain change or jump, continuous tracking with occasional whip pans and snap zooms, heavy motion blur, dust/snow particle hits, and impact shakes on every landing. No text, no graphics, no slow-motion except brief speed-ramps into the biggest airs.
BGM: hard-hitting electronic / drum-heavy future bass or aggressive cinematic trailer music with deep sub drops, risers, and glitch fills locked to every jump and landing; tire screeches, rock impacts, wind whooshes and bike suspension compressions are rhythmic sound-design elements. Peak energy on the biggest airs (CUT 06, 10, 28) and end with a cold, fading wind stinger.
Premium AAA quality, photorealistic cinematic rendering, extreme sports documentary style, consistent rider and bike design, exactly 30 cuts.

title: House Party Found Footage
prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic smartphone found-footage video of a massive suburban house party at night. It should feel like chaotic footage captured on different partygoers’ phones, with realistic handheld movement rather than polished cinematography. All visible people are clearly 21+ adults.
Use the provided reference image as the strict visual reference for the main woman. Keep her face, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, body proportions, outfit, makeup and accessories consistent and recognizable throughout.
TIMELINE
0–5s — Arrival: Start directly inside a crowded house. A shaky phone follows the woman through dancing guests. Show friends greeting her, packed hallways, phones recording, warm lights, flashes, laughter and raised cups with soft drinks.
5–10s — Interior Party: The crowd becomes denser. Show the woman dancing with friends, spontaneous dance circles, confetti, group selfies, food-covered counters and flashing phones. Use quick reframing, autofocus shifts, motion blur and people briefly blocking the lens.
10–15s — Pool Reveal: Hard cut to a huge backyard packed with adults around a swimming pool, lawn, patio and balcony. Show dancing, safe pool jumps, splashing water, colorful inflatables, string lights and sprinklers. Briefly let water or a person obstruct the phone.
15–20s — Giant Celebration: Everyone joins one enormous group moment. Show raised hands, cheering, streamers, bubbles, beach balls, confetti and multiple phones filming. Keep the woman clearly recognizable at the center while the camera is pulled through the crowd.
20–25s — Party Everywhere: Rapid cuts between the porch, lawn, garden, living room and backyard. Show dancing, snacks, glowing wristbands, playful videos, countdowns, cheering and confetti. The scale and energy should continue increasing.
25–30s — Finale: Reach maximum intensity. The woman dances with friends, looks directly into the phone and smiles before reaching toward the camera. The phone spins through laughing faces, lights and confetti, then falls safely onto a cushioned outdoor chair. Friends lean into frame laughing and waving. End abruptly mid-celebration.
VISUAL STYLE
Use 40–50 rapid micro-cuts, generally 0.4–0.8 seconds each. Authentic smartphone footage: strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, tilted horizons, accidental whip-pans, autofocus hunting, rolling-shutter wobble, natural motion blur, low-light digital noise, clipped flash highlights, lens smears and frequent foreground obstructions. No cinematic stabilization, drone shots, slow motion, beauty filters, glossy nightclub look or artificial glitch effects.
AUDIO
Original bass-heavy party music recorded through smartphone microphones, layered with adult conversations, cheering, laughter, footsteps, pool splashes, sprinklers, wind and phone sounds. Realistic microphone compression and mild clipping, with intensity increasing toward the finale.
Overall: Make it feel like an enormous, unpredictable, playful and believable 30-second viral camera-roll montage, with the party growing continuously bigger and more chaotic while the main woman remains visually consistent.

背景中不出现闲杂人物，不出现直升机，不出现无人机，不出现其他角色；只有风、雨、玻璃反光、高空雾气和两名主角。

全片必须维持真实电影感：

title: Marriage Million Dollar Drama
prompt:
Create a 30 second cinematic drama in 16:9 with grounded late 1980s to early 1990s luxury atmosphere, photographed as if on 35mm film with natural human imperfections, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain, restrained contrast, accurate reflections, physical fabric movement, consistent faces, hands, jewelry, hair and wardrobe across every shot.
0 to 5 seconds. Interior of an elegant private hotel suite at night. A sophisticated wealthy man in a black tuxedo stands near dark polished wood and warm tungsten lamps. He calmly presents an outrageous financial proposition to a married couple. Begin with a steady medium close shot on him using an 85mm lens, then cut to the husband in a pale gray suit against cool silver curtains, then to the wife in a sculptural black evening dress. Their reactions are controlled but visibly shaken. Use shallow depth of field, soft practical light, realistic eye movement and tiny facial tension.
5 to 11 seconds. Move into intimate reaction shots. The husband gives a disbelieving half smile that fades. The wife stares silently, breathing shallowly. Return to the wealthy man, completely composed. Camera remains mostly locked with tiny operator drift and gentle lens breathing. Preserve the 180 degree eyeline logic. No theatrical gestures.
11 to 17 seconds. Cut to the couple in bed later that night under cool blue moonlight. White sheets, dark headboard, soft shadows. Alternate close views of her sleepless face, his troubled profile, their hands resting close but not touching, then a wider overhead composition showing emotional distance. Their eyes stay open. Add subtle chest breathing, cloth compression and natural blinking.
17 to 22 seconds. Morning in the same suite. Warm daylight enters through sheer curtains. A lawyer and the wealthy man finalize paperwork while the couple stands together in uneasy silence. Show a restrained handshake, a pen touching paper, the husband looking toward his wife, then a close shot of her trying to remain composed.
22 to 27 seconds. Night exterior on a luxury yacht or terrace above dark water. The wife now wears an elegant black lace evening dress and sparkling earrings. The wealthy man wears an ivory dinner jacket. Cool blue night light wraps their faces while distant harbor lights create soft bokeh. He speaks gently. She studies him with guarded emotion. Include a slow subtle push toward her face, real wind moving a few loose hairs, and reflections trembling on the water.
27 to 30 seconds. He flips a small coin into the air as if leaving the next decision to chance. Follow the coin briefly, then cut to her eyes, then to a tense close two shot where they stand inches apart without melodrama. End on a quiet unresolved expression and hold for half a second.
Audio uses a restrained cinematic score with low piano notes, soft strings, distant bass pulse and almost inaudible room tone. Music begins sparse, builds tension through the bedroom and contract sequence, then becomes intimate and uncertain on the yacht. Add realistic clothing rustle, pen movement, footsteps, soft water ambience and one crisp metallic coin sound. No lyrics. No on screen text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Avoid glossy commercial lighting, excessive slow motion, warped hands, face changes, floating objects, plastic skin, impossible reflections, exaggerated depth of field or artificial camera motion.

title: Rainy Airport Farewell Drama
prompt:
时长：精确30秒  
画幅：16:9，720p  
镜头数量：4个主要镜头  
声音：无BGM，只有雨声、机场环境声、人物呼吸和行李箱滚轮声
## 角色与空间锁定
- 女主 {{Mixed 1}} 严格保持参考图中的脸。
- 男主 {{Mixed 2}} 严格保持参考图中的脸。
- 场景保持参考图 {{Mixed 3}} 中的雨夜机场出发层、玻璃自动门、冷白顶灯、湿地反光和道路暖色车灯。

- 女主靠近画面左侧机场入口，面向右侧车道；男主从画面右侧进入。正反打保持女主看向画面右侧、男主看向画面左侧。
## 表演核心
女主 来机场 以前已经决定离开，但内心仍然给男主 保留了最后一次机会。她真正想听到的不是解释，而是一个足以让她相信“这次会不一样”的理由。
她的表情不能从期待突然切换成愤怒，也不能从心软突然切换成冷漠。前一种情绪要残留在后一种情绪中：
- 她受伤时，嘴角还残留着见到男主的笑意；
- 她质问时，眼睛仍然在等待他的答案；
- 她说狠话时，声音比眼神更坚定；
- 她离开时，身体已经做出决定，情感却还停在男主身边。
## 0–4秒｜她假装自己已经不在乎
35mm中远景，缓慢推近。
女主 站在机场 入口外，右手握着行李箱。她看似准备随时离开，注意力却一直停留在右侧车道。
男主 从雨夜车灯中出现。
女主看见他的瞬间，原本克制的脸不受控制地松了一下。那不是完整的笑，而是某种“他终于还是来了”的安心。她几乎要朝他走过去，却在发现男主没有加快脚步时停住。
她努力把刚才的反应藏起来，轻声说：
女主：“So… you came.”
说完后，她仍看着他。嘴角的微小笑意没有马上消失，眼睛却已经开始观察他的神情，害怕他接下来要说的话。
## 4–9秒｜她差一点替他找好借口
切50mm女主近景，此后保持镜头，不切男主。
男主在画外说：
男主：“It was a mistake.”
女主最先出现的不是愤怒，而是一声几乎没有发出来的短促气息，像是想笑，也像是松了一口气——她差一点把这句话理解为道歉。
她的嘴唇已经准备说出“Okay”，但声音没有出来。
半秒之后，她才意识到：男主说的是“一个错误”，不是他怎样伤害了她。
刚才残留在嘴角的笑意没有立刻消失，而是停留得稍微久了一点，逐渐变成难以维持的苦涩。她低下眼睛，像是在替自己感到难堪。
握着行李箱的手先松开一点，又重新收紧。
## 9–15秒｜她在质问，也在给他最后一次机会
镜头继续停留在女主脸上。
她抬头时，眼睛已经眼周泛红，但神情没有变得强硬。她仍然希望男主能说出一个不同的答案。
女主：“Which part?”
她原本想用讽刺保护自己，但声音比预想中更轻。说完后，她短暂避开男主的目光，重新吸气：
女主：“Lying to me… or thinking I’d stay?”
前半句带着受伤后的锋利；说到“stay”时，声音却不明显地软了一下。
台词结束后，她没有立刻摆出决绝表情，而是安静看着男主。她的眼神仍在等他回答，像是在无声地给他最后一次机会。
这段停顿里，愤怒和期待必须同时存在。
## 15–21秒｜熟悉的温柔差点让她放弃决定
切50mm侧面双人中景，保持两人的距离和手部位置清楚。
男主向她靠近半步，抬手想碰她的脸：
男主：“I still love you.”
女主保持站着不动，听见这句话，女主的防备不是立刻变强，而是先松开。
她看着男主，眼神迅速恢复了过去面对他时的柔软。她差一点闭上眼睛接受男主的触碰。
就在男主的手即将碰到她之前，女主看见他脸上熟悉的请求原谅的神情。她意识到，这一幕以前发生过。
她没有猛然后退，只是停在那里。眼里的温柔没有消失，却慢慢蒙上一层失望。
她轻微低下头用近乎请求的气声说：
女主：“Don’t.”
这句“Don’t”既是在阻止男主，也是在阻止自己再次心软。
男主的手停在半空，没有触碰她。
## 21–26秒｜她必须在自己再次原谅他之前结束
切85mm女主近景。
女主没有马上退开。她抬头看着男主，眼神里保留着刚才的温柔。正因为还爱他，接下来的话才显得困难。
她的嘴唇动了一下，像想说另一句话，最后却低下眼睛：

这句话说得很轻，不像指控，更像她终于承认了一个早已知道的事实。
她停顿。呼吸开始不稳，眼眶中的泪光（眼眶含泪不落）继续增加。她抬眼重新看向男主，想把最后一句完整说出来：

声音在这里短暂卡住。
她没有立刻接下去，而是看了男主一秒，像是在确认自己是否真的舍得结束。
随后，她吸入一小口气：
女主：“…are done.”
“done”说得清楚，却没有愤怒。尾音落下时，她的眼神仍然舍不得离开男主。
## 26–30秒｜身体先离开，感情晚一步跟上
切35mm侧面中景，固定机位。
女主转身拉动行李箱。转身动作没有干脆利落，而是略微迟缓，仿佛身体在等待男主再次叫住她。
她向机场入口迈出两步。
在自动门前，她的步伐停顿很短的一瞬。头部没有回转，但目光不自觉地向男主所在方向偏移，像是最后一次确认他是否会追上来。
男主没有动作。
女主眼里的泪水终于从眼角滑落一滴。她没有擦，也没有再等待，重新迈步进入机场。
自动门开始打开，她穿过入口。画面结束在她跨过门槛的背影上，不表现关门，不使用倒影。
## 表演连续性
- 女主看见男主时产生的安心不能完全消失，要逐渐变成受伤和自嘲。
- 质问时不能只有愤怒；台词结束后的眼神必须仍在等待答案。
- 听见“I still love you”后，必须先出现真实的心软，再出现自我阻止，不能提前后退。
- “Don’t”不是冷酷命令，而是带着请求感的自我保护。
- “We are done”不要一字一顿地强硬宣布；“We”短暂卡住，表现她并不情愿结束。
- 女主离开时不能瞬间恢复坚定。她可以迟疑，但不能回头。
- 全程避免挑眉、抿嘴、握拳、落泪等动作逐项轮换；所有变化都从上一种情绪中自然生长出来。
- 不使用表情归零、突然冷脸、戏剧化瞪眼、夸张哭腔或胜利式转身。

基础设定：一段青衣女侠与白衣女侠对剑的画面。两人均一只手持剑，另一只手没有拿任何东西。中式写实武侠动作电影质感，一镜到底完成整段双人对剑，场景在古街 对峙，画面仅有两个女侠。全程保持中景到全景，人物始终完整可见，画面中必须同时清楚保留两名剑客的身体姿态、持剑手、步法与两剑之间的距离关系；绝不切换特写，绝不拍脸部特写、手部特写、剑刃特写或火花特写，不使用慢镜头，不使用跳切，不使用定格。镜头以高速跟拍、侧向滑轨、环绕运镜、前冲后拉和轻微升降为主，始终跟随招式推进。动作深度参考中式武侠的剑术设计：剑走身随、腰胯发力、步法抢位、贴剑卸力、虚实变招、进退连贯；强调轻盈、凌厉与真实冲击，形成中式武侠电影中“人随剑走、剑带身转、进退皆有章法”的视觉冲击。完全真人写实质感，中式真人武侠风格，电影感，仅生成音效，不要生成背景音乐。
画面一：青衣女侠从画面左前方疾步切入，前脚点地、后脚发力，身体压低后骤然向上挑起，以轻功般轻盈但有明确起跳力量的斜跃穿过石板地面。她在半空中收膝转胯，剑锋由低至高斜刺白衣女侠肩侧空隙；白衣女侠不与之硬碰，先以极短的侧滑步离开剑线，身体向后微仰，衣摆随避让动作掠开，剑身贴着青衣女侠的剑脊向外一拨，利用贴剑引力令来剑擦身而过。青衣女侠以落地脚为轴继续旋开，剑锋顺势横扫；白衣女侠立即低身，膝盖深屈、上身后倾，从横扫剑线下轻盈避过，同时后手沉腕，将剑尖从低位斜挑向青衣女侠的落脚方向。摄影机从二人斜侧前方高速跟进，保持完整中景，在青衣女侠起跳时略微向上升，在白衣女侠低身闪避时同步下沉，完整保留两人从空中出剑、贴剑卸力、落地转身到低身回击的连续动作。
画面二：白衣女侠借低位挑剑逼迫青衣女侠横移，连续发动三条不同方向的剑线：先是一记由下向上的挑刺，再迅速收剑变为横向削切，最后以前送步贴近，剑尖直取中线。三次进攻必须像一组紧凑连招，方向清楚、节奏递进，不是重复地两剑相撞。青衣女侠先以侧身让过挑刺，随后脚尖轻点地面，身体横向掠开半步，剑锋仅以极小幅度拨开横削；面对最后的直刺，她不后退，而是突然借前脚踏地腾起，做一个短促、轻灵的斜向跃步。她在空中将身体侧卷，白衣女侠的剑锋从青衣女侠腰侧下方穿过，青衣女侠同时翻腕出剑，自上向下压向白衣女侠剑背。白衣女侠迅速向外转肩，将剑抽离而非硬抗，二人剑刃只短暂擦过，迸出极少量细碎火星。镜头沿着白衣女侠连续变招的方向侧向滑动，再围绕二人向内环绕约四分之一圈。
画面三：青衣女侠落地后立即借旋转余势发动反攻。她先做一次低位虚晃，剑尖贴近地面向白衣女侠前脚掠去，引得白衣女侠抬步避让；青衣女侠随即突然收剑、沉肩、转腰，身体完成干净利落的旋身出剑。旋身不是原地展示，而是带着向前切入的步法：前半圈将剑收于身侧蓄力，后半圈借腰胯和肩线将剑锋横斩而出。白衣女侠快速后撤半步，身体后仰，剑锋从其胸前极近处掠过；她在后仰未尽时，以脚尖为支点轻轻旋回，白衣长袖与衣摆形成流畅惯性，剑尖从外侧绕出，反刺青衣女侠转身后的背侧空隙。青衣女侠凭借腰部扭转及时察觉，以背身状态将剑反手横在身后完成盲位格挡。两剑在身侧发生第一次明确重碰，金属撞击短促有力，火花沿剑刃接触点向外飞散，青衣女侠向前滑步卸力，白衣女侠借后撤转身重新回正。
画面四：双方同时抓住彼此剑路回收的瞬间，发动最后一轮连招。青衣女侠向前抢位，先刺上路，白衣女侠侧身避开；青衣女侠立刻变为低位削切，白衣女侠轻跃收腿避让；青衣女侠再以旋身出剑横斩，白衣女侠在落地同时以身体后仰、剑身斜封化开。白衣女侠顺势以一记短促飞踢踢向青衣女侠腰侧，青衣女侠向外撤胯、抬肘护身，以剑格和步法共同让开踢击，随后借退步回弹，重新送出一记直线快剑。白衣女侠此时不再闪避，而是迎上前去，以沉肩、坠肘、转腕完成最后一次坚实格挡。两把剑在双方之间正面猛烈对碰，爆出火星呈短线状向两侧飞散，双剑受力后迅速分开。碰撞必须有冲击感：两人的剑臂被震开，前脚同时滑退半步，衣摆与剑穗因反震而甩动，但没有任何一人倒地、脱手或明显落败。
动作风格要求：深度参考传统中式武侠动作设计，所有攻防都遵循“试探、抢位、格挡、卸力、变招、反击、再平衡”的逻辑；动作凌厉、短促、有爆发力，出剑与收剑都干净利落，强调腰胯驱动、沉肩坠肘、步法换位、剑身引导和真实受力，不要西式击剑姿态，不要杂乱挥砍，不要魔法剑气，不要夸张腾空，不要无意义翻滚。每次格挡都要有剑刃接触、力量转移和后续变招；每次飞踢都要有起跳、闪避、落地和重心恢复；每次旋身出剑都要先蓄势再发力；每次双剑碰撞的火花都要短促、真实、具有金属摩擦质感。画面整体保持紧凑、冷峻、强冲击力的中式武侠电影节奏。
禁止剑气特效，禁止人物变形，禁止多余手臂，禁止武器穿模，禁止动作断裂，禁止杂乱群演，禁止字幕、水印、文字。

title: Rooftop Staff Training Duel
prompt:
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action Korean school rooftop martial-arts training scene at sunset using the provided character and rooftop references. Preserve Seolran and Mujin’s exact faces, hairstyles, bodies and school uniforms, and keep their staffs visually identical to the references.
Tell a completely original training story: Seolran calmly tests Mujin’s footwork rather than attacking continuously. She approaches with her white staff, gives Mujin the dark staff, and begins with quick controlled feints. Mujin initially reacts too quickly and keeps moving in the wrong direction. Seolran repeatedly redirects him using precise staff movements without seriously hitting him. Around the middle, Mujin stops watching the staff and starts reading her shoulders, hips and feet. He successfully avoids the next attack with a small controlled pivot, showing that he has learned.
Mujin then places his dark staff on the rooftop and continues the exercise unarmed. Seolran makes several controlled circular staff movements while Mujin uses smart footwork to avoid them. He gets a clear opportunity to counter but chooses not to attack, showing restraint. Seolran finally lowers her staff and gives him a subtle approving nod. Mujin responds with a small focused smile.
Use 7 distinct shots with different camera positions: wide sunset establishing shot, low footwork angle, side tracking shot, close-up of their faces, medium two-shot, moving orbital shot, and final wide rooftop shot.
Make it look like genuine premium Korean live-action: realistic skin, natural blinking and breathing, authentic school-uniform fabric, believable physics, real staff weight, subtle handheld movement, natural sunset lighting, realistic motion blur and restrained cinematic grain. No supernatural martial arts, no wire-fu, no exaggerated acting, no CGI, no extra people, no extra limbs, no weapon duplication, no subtitles, no music, no logos or watermarks.

title: Quiet Parisian Apartment Portrait
prompt:
Young Caucasian woman, chin-length auburn bob haircut, green eyes, wearing a pink short top and white denim shorts, sitting pensively on a sofa inside a large bright suburban Parisian house, summer daytime, sunlight through the windows, young adults dancing and laughing around her holding drinks, loud music implied by energetic crowd movement.
She rises from the sofa empty-handed, walks toward a kitchen table lined with alcohol bottles and glasses. Handheld camera follows close behind her shoulder, slightly shaky. 
She pours herself a glass of champagne, sips it. Camera holds behind her, shaky, close distance. 
She weaves through the dancing, laughing crowd, some standing, some in groups laughing on sofas, toward a large glass bay window. Camera continues following close behind her, no cut. 
She steps outside into the garden, a big pool comes into view with young adults swimming and laughing inside it. Camera smoothly rotates from following behind her to facing her. She looks toward the pool with amusement, smiles, sets her champagne glass down on a small table beside a lounge chair. 
 She removes her jersey, places it on the back of the lounge chair, then removes her white denim shorts, places them on the lounge chair, revealing a swimsuit underneath. Camera holds a medium shot facing her, slight handheld sway.  She walks toward the pool, camera repositions behind her as she walks, then she breaks into a run. Handheld camera follows close, shaky, matching her pace. 
She dives into the pool shouting "take care", landing in the water among other laughing young adults. Camera dives in with her, briefly submerged underwater alongside the swimmers. 
She resurfaces laughing, joins the laughing adults nearby. Camera is up in the air, revealing a wide aerial view of the house, garden and pool.
Bright natural summer daylight, warm sunlit color palette, candid documentary energy, slight handheld lens wobble throughout.

title: Ancient Dragon Lake Companion
prompt:
Duration: 30 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
STYLE:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action fantasy film with premium Hollywood creature VFX, realistic human performance, natural environmental physics, cinematic HDR lighting and detailed practical-looking textures.
MAIN CHARACTER:
Use Image 1 only for the woman's recognizable facial identity, facial features, hairstyle and body proportions.
She wears a completely different outfit: an elegant deep-olive traveling cloak over a fitted cream tunic, dark brown trousers and worn leather ankle boots. A small leather satchel hangs across her shoulder.
Keep her identity and appearance consistent throughout.
CREATURE:
A gigantic ancient ivory dragon with subtle warm-gold scales rests beside a misty mountain lake.
Its enormous wings are folded naturally. Its body shows realistic age, weathering and old scars, but it is peaceful rather than threatening.
Fine scales, worn horns, small scratches and natural imperfections are clearly visible.
Its breathing is slow and subtle.
LOCATION:
A vast alpine valley surrounding a crystal-clear mountain lake.
Tall wild grass, pale blue flowers, moss-covered rocks, distant cliffs and thin waterfalls surround the water.
Early morning sunlight breaks through low clouds.
Light mist drifts across the lake.
A gentle breeze moves the grass and the woman's cloak.
The atmosphere is peaceful, mysterious and emotional.
00–05s — ARRIVAL
Begin with a wide shot looking across the misty lake.
The woman slowly walks along the shoreline.
The camera tracks beside her at a low height.
She notices enormous footprints disappearing toward the mountains.
She stops and looks ahead.
05–10s — THE DISCOVERY
The camera moves behind her as she follows the footprints around a large rock formation.
The enormous dragon is suddenly revealed resting beside the lake.
Its folded wing rises far above the surrounding grass.
The woman stops several meters away.
She remains calm and simply observes it.
10–15s — THE LAKE
The dragon slowly opens one eye.
The woman notices the movement.
Instead of approaching directly, she walks toward the edge of the lake.
She kneels and touches the water with her fingertips.
Small ripples spread across the surface.
The dragon watches quietly from behind her.
15–20s — QUIET RESPONSE
A gentle breeze crosses the valley.
The dragon slowly lowers its enormous head toward the shoreline.
Its breath creates a soft movement across the grass and mist.
The woman slowly stands.
She turns toward the creature without fear.
The camera moves between them, emphasizing their enormous difference in scale.
20–25s — CLOSE ENCOUNTER
The woman carefully takes one step forward.
The dragon lowers its head until its eye is almost level with her.
She raises one hand.
After a brief pause, the dragon calmly moves closer and allows her to place her hand against one small section of its weathered scales.
Her expression becomes quietly amazed.
No magical glow or exaggerated effect.
25–30s — FINAL WIDE SHOT
The dragon gently closes its eye.
The woman steps backward and looks across the mountain lake.
The camera slowly rises above them.
The woman appears tiny beside the enormous creature.
Mist moves across the water while sunlight breaks through the clouds.
The dragon remains peacefully resting beside the lake.
