title: Supply Run Anaconda Ambush
prompt:
A muddy dirt track through thick green rainforest in grey daylight. An army supply convoy of trucks drives along the narrow track, jungle pressing in on both sides. A giant python, thick as a bus with dark green scales, has wrapped around the last truck and is dragging it backward into the trees. At the front, a gunner stands at a mounted gun on the lead gun-truck. Sound: roaring engines, groaning metal, soldiers shouting, snake hissing, rifle fire, radio voices.
Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear shot in the mud. The giant python squeezes the last truck and hauls it backward off the track into the trees, wheels sliding in the mud. Soldiers on the truck fire their rifles into the thick coils, but the bullets do nothing. The rear driver wrestles his wheel and shouts into his radio: "IT'S PULLING ME INTO THE TREES!"
Shot 2 (3–6s): At the front of the convoy. The gunner swings his mounted gun around to point back down the line, but holds his fire — the snake is wrapped on the truck with men still on it. He calls on the radio: "Cut your trailer! Get it on the track!"
Shot 3 (6–9s): At the rear truck. The driver pulls the trailer release. The truck breaks free and lurches forward onto the track — and the python, still wrapped around the heavy trailer, is yanked out of the trees with it, spilling onto the open muddy track, rearing its head up in the clear.
Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The snake is out in the open on the track now. The lead gunner opens fire. Bullet time — a long stream of heavy rounds flies down the line in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, tearing into the coiled python, mud and broken branches bursting up around it.
Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The python drops and lies still across the muddy track beside the wrecked trailer, smoke rising off it. The freed rear truck pulls up the line to the others, soldiers climbing down into the mud. Smoke drifts through the trees. Cut.

title: Time-Travel Chase Through Golden Portals
prompt:
[Prompt extracted from thread]
THE RUNNER sprints through a crumbling stone archway and into blinding light — Ancient Rome erupts around them. Marble columns, torchlit shadows, the roar of a coliseum crowd in the distance. But footsteps echo behind them. THE HUNTER emerges through a golden shimmer, sword drawn. THE RUNNER vaults over a merchant cart, scattering goods. The Hunter slashes through a hanging tapestry. The Runner grabs a gladius from a weapons rack and parries. Sparks fly. The Hunter kicks them backward through a golden portal.
Feudal Japan. Cherry blossoms. Bamboo grove. THE RUNNER tumbles into a serene garden, catches breath behind a stone lantern. THE HUNTER appears at the garden's edge, blade glinting. For a moment, neither moves — just wind and falling petals. Then the Hunter lunges. THE RUNNER draws a katana just in time. Steel meets steel. The exchange is fast, precise, intimate. Bamboo shadows dance across their movements. A sudden golden rift splits the garden floor — they both stumble through it.
Cyberpunk megacity. Neon rain. A narrow alley choked with holographic advertisements and steam vents. THE RUNNER rolls behind a hovering motorcycle, scans for an exit. THE HUNTER emerges from the shadows, rain dripping from their armor. The Runner spots a fire escape — lunges for it. The Hunter throws a blade. It catches the Runner's sleeve, pins them to a metal beam. The Runner pulls free, leaving cloth behind. They scramble up, reach the rooftop, and freeze.
Behind them: THE HUNTER. No more running. The Runner's back meets the roof's edge. One wrong step means the fall. The Hunter advances slowly, savoring the moment. THE RUNNER glances down — thirty stories of neon-soaked city below. Then: a wild card. A motorbike revving on the street below. THE RUNNER takes a breath, steps backward off the roof, and grabs the bike's handlebars mid-flight. They tumble onto the seat. The bike swerves through traffic. In slow motion, the bike leans into a sharp turn, showering sparks. THE RUNNER looks back up — THE HUNTER stands at the roof's edge, watching. Then a golden portal opens beside the Hunter. They step through.
The Runner laughs, breathless. THE HUNTER reappears on a parallel rooftop, materializing from another golden rift. The chase continues.
"You can't outrun time!"
THE RUNNER (laughing back over his shoulder): "Watch me."
QUALITY ANCHOR
Shot on ARRI Alexa, anamorphic lenses, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, natural motion blur, volumetric lighting, cinematic color grade, 4K, subtle film grain.

title: Extreme Skydiving Scene
prompt:

Image 1 is the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve her exact face, pale skin, striking blue eyes, long straight black hair, slim feminine body, and the same stylish jet ski outfit. Do not change her identity, hair, body, or outfit.
Open ocean, bright daylight, deep blue water, rolling waves, white foam, heavy spray, strong wind, and raw cinematic action. The scene must feel fast, realistic, thrilling, and physically intense.
The whole video is one continuous 15-second shot: no cuts, no hidden cuts, no transitions, no montage. Use natural motion blur, water droplets on the lens, jet ski engine roar, wave impacts, wind noise, and believable body-weight corrections. Do not make the motion look sped up or unnatural.
The camera must always stay very close to her and the jet ski. The video begins with an extreme close front shot on her face, upper body, and handlebars while she is already riding fast but naturally, seated on the jet ski. Her wet black hair moves in the wind, her blue eyes look focused and fearless, and spray hits the lens.
In one smooth unbroken move, the camera passes closely around her side and moves behind her. Once behind the jet ski, it drops very low, almost touching the water, and stays close until the end, following tightly from behind and slightly below the rear, locked near the wake, tail, and engine spray.
The first major action is a power slide that becomes a tight donut circle. She leans the jet ski sideways and carves a controlled circle on the water. The jet ski is clearly tilted, not flat. While carving, she leans her upper body toward the camera, turns her face toward us, and looks directly at us. At the same time, she reaches one hand down and drags her fingertips across the water.
At the exact moment her fingertips touch the water, the video briefly shifts into a short slow motion. This moment highlights her hand touching the surface, the spray, her eye contact, and the tilted circular motion of the jet ski. It must feel stylish, controlled, and natural.
As soon as this brief slow motion ends, she exits the circle naturally and immediately faces a large wave already very close ahead. Do not show a long empty ride. She reaches the wave almost instantly, with the camera still extremely close behind her at water level.
She attacks the wave and launches into the main aerial jump. This becomes the longer final slow-motion highlight. During the airborne moment, the camera should not spin like the whole image is rotating. Instead, it starts from the close rear trailing position and moves in a smooth curved arc around her side, naturally passing from behind her to in front of her, ending with a tight focus on her face and upper body.
During the main slow motion, she stays standing with strong balance, pulls the handlebars, lifts the nose slightly, and performs a stylish controlled trick. As the camera reaches the front, she looks directly at us and gives a confident cinematic smile. Her hair lifts in the wind, sea spray freezes in the air, and sunlight glows through the droplets.
At the end of the slow-motion move, the jet ski descends toward the water. Slow motion gradually returns to real speed just before impact so the landing feels powerful. The camera stays close as the jet ski slams onto the water, spray explodes over the lens, and she absorbs the landing with her knees before continuing forward.
No text, no logos, no subtitles, no extra riders, no boats, no montage, no cuts.

title: Anaconda Train
prompt:
A giant anaconda, thick as a bus with dark green scales, has wrapped itself around a speeding train that is carrying big barrels of oil, racing through open daylight. A long bridge is coming up ahead over a wide river. An army helicopter flies alongside the train, an armed soldier with a bazooka leaning out of the open door. Sound: roaring train, screaming chopper blades, groaning metal, snake hissing, radio voices.
Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Fast side tracking shot through the air. The giant anaconda's huge coils are wrapped all over the oil train, squeezing the carriages and the oil barrels as the train speeds down the track. The helicopter flies right beside it. The soldier in the open door points at the train driver and shouts on the radio: "YOU CAN'T SAVE THE TRAIN! WE HAVE TO BLOW IT! GET READY TO JUMP!"
Shot 2 (3–6s): Closer on the helicopter and the train engine. The bridge gets bigger ahead through the windshield. The pilot brings the helicopter down low and close, right next to the engine where the driver leans out of his cab. The soldier braces the bazooka and yells: "BRIDGE IS COMING! JUMP NOW — I'VE GOT YOU!"
Shot 3 (6–9s): On the train engine. The driver climbs out of his cab into the wind, the snake's head striking toward him, and he leaps off the train — catching the helicopter's landing skid underneath and hanging on with both hands, legs swinging over the rushing ground.
Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The chopper swerves hard left and away as the snake-wrapped train rolls out onto the bridge over the river. The soldier fires the bazooka. Bullet time — the rocket flies across the frame in slow motion, smoke trailing behind it, straight into the oil train on the bridge. The driver hangs from the skid, watching. The rocket hits.
Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The whole train and the giant anaconda go up in one massive rolling fireball on the bridge, oil barrels bursting, fire and smoke shooting into the sky. The helicopter pulls away from the blast, the driver still hanging from the skid.

title: Marital Conflict Scene
prompt:

镜头01（0-5秒）：双人MS，35mm，前侧三分之四角度。妻子攥着转让合同，指节发白，猛地将合同拍在收银台上："你凭什么卖掉我们的店？"丈夫身体僵住，压着声音回答："不卖，你拿什么还债？"妻子眼神震动一瞬，随即怒意更深；雨水不断敲打玻璃门。

镜头03（8-13秒）：反打丈夫CU，保持正确视线。他被这句话击中，怒意短暂停住，随后低声却激烈地说："我只是不能再看着你一个人撑下去！"切回双人MS，妻子绕过收银台冲到他面前，却在一步之外停住。她举起合同似乎还想质问，手臂最终无力垂下："可你从来没有问过我，愿不愿意被你这样救。"

title: Alien Creature vs Cop vs Soldier
prompt:
A gigantic alien creature — wet black skin, many glowing eyes, and a long whip-like tongue — stands over a busy highway bridge in bright daylight. It uses its tongue to grab moving cars off the road and lift them up to its mouth. An army truck with a big anti-aircraft gun is parked further down the bridge. Sound: screaming traffic, crunching metal, the alien's wet roar, gun motors, radio chatter.
Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot along the bridge. The giant alien's tongue whips out and wraps around a speeding car, lifting it high into the air toward its open mouth full of teeth. Other cars swerve and crash. Inside a police car, our hero — a young cop — slams the brakes, staring up through the windshield, shouting into his radio: "IT'S PICKING UP CARS! IT'S EATING THEM OFF THE ROAD!"
Shot 2 (3–6s): At the army truck down the bridge. A soldier sits behind the big anti-aircraft gun, swinging the barrel up toward the alien, but holding fire — the alien's mouth is shut. He shouts on the radio: "I can only hurt it when its mouth opens! Somebody make it open wide — then I fire!"
Shot 3 (6–9s): The alien creatures tongue suddenly wraps the hero's police car and lifts it upside down, high over the alien's open jaws. Inside, hanging from his seatbelt, the cop pulls out his shotgun, points it down through his own windshield at the alien's mouth below, and yells: "OPEN WIDE!" He fires. The alien roars in pain, its huge mouth opening wide.
Shot 4 (9–14s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The mouth is open. Bullet time — the soldier in the tank sees his chance fires the anti-aircraft gun in slow motion, a stream of glowing shells flying across the bridge straight into the alien creatures open mouth, the alien's head jerking back, black blood and broken teeth hanging in the air. The tongue lets go of the car.
Shot 5 (14–15s): Time snaps back. The huge alien folds backward and crashes down over the bridge railing, sliding off into the river below. The police car drops onto the road and bounces, the cop climbing out, shotgun still in hand. Smoke drifts across the bridge.

Tiny broken robot.

Messy bedroom workshop at night.
Desk covered with tools, wires, screws, batteries, notebooks, and a warm desk lamp.

The teen repairs their tiny robot companion late at night.

cut4:

The teen tightens a microscopic screw, face blurred in the background.

cut5:

cut6:

cut7:
Medium shot.

cut8:

cut9:

cut10:

prompt:

title: Extreme Skateboarding Cliff Jump
prompt:
Create a hyper-cinematic 15-second continuous single-take extreme downhill skateboard video.
REFERENCE USAGE:
Image 1 = strict identity, outfit, and skateboard reference. Preserve her exact face, pale skin, blue eyes, long straight black hair, body proportions, flowing deep red asymmetrical dress with side cutouts, black wrist guards, black knee pads, black skate shoes with white soles, and black skateboard with red graphics and red wheels. Do NOT change identity, outfit, or skateboard. Do NOT turn it into a longboard. She must feel like a real person doing dangerous but believable downhill skateboard action.
SETTING:
A steep narrow mountain coastal road in bright daylight, with huge green cliffs, tropical vegetation, sharp bends, white road markings, and the ocean far below. Fast, dangerous, raw, cinematic, physically believable.
VIDEO STYLE:
One continuous 15-second shot, no cuts or transitions. Hyper-realistic action, low 24–35mm lens, handheld chase-camera energy, natural motion blur, asphalt vibration, wind noise, skateboard wheel rumble, fabric flapping, and visible body-weight corrections.
OPENING SHOT:
She starts standing still on the mountain road, holding the skateboard in one hand. The camera begins in front of her, focused on her upper body and face. Her black hair moves in the wind, the red dress flutters, and her expression is calm, focused, fearless. She lowers the skateboard to the asphalt, steps onto it, then pushes forward with one foot several times to build speed.
CAMERA MOVEMENT:
As she starts moving, the camera stays in front briefly, tracking backward while she accelerates. Then, in one smooth fast move, it swings around her body to the back and drops very low to skateboard level, close to the tail and slightly offset. From then on, it stays near road level, emphasizing speed, wheels, asphalt texture, board movement, and the flying red dress.
ACTION FLOW:
After gaining speed, she places both feet on the skateboard and begins fast controlled downhill carving. She stays crouched low and athletic. The skateboard cuts across the road with smooth aggressive control. Her dress streams behind her, hair flying, knees flexing, shoulders correcting balance. She carves through a quick left-right sequence, passing close to road markings and the cliff edge. The camera stays glued behind the skateboard, tracking every carve and wheel vibration.
Midway, she reaches a dangerous sharp hairpin bend where a lower road is visible below. Instead of following the turn, she commits straight toward the cliff edge, crouches deeper, builds speed, and launches off with the skateboard beneath her feet.
The instant she leaves the edge, the video shifts into dramatic slow motion. The camera rises slightly with her while staying close. In midair, she clearly grabs the skateboard with one hand and turns her face toward the camera, making direct eye contact with the viewer. Her red dress spreads dramatically, hair floats, and the ocean valley opens beneath her.
She descends and lands hard onto the lower road, knees absorbing impact, skateboard wheels slapping the asphalt. The camera shakes from the force but stays locked behind her. She instantly regains control and continues downhill at full speed.
FINAL MOMENT:
She keeps charging forward, low and aggressive, red dress trailing behind her. The camera remains close behind the skateboard as she powers into the next curve and disappears down the mountain road. No text, no logos, no subtitles.

title: Chinese Female Warrior Slays Demonic Beast
prompt:
A realistic martial arts demon-hunting film: Deep within a cave, an explosion occurs. The rock walls shatter, releasing a torrent of dense black demonic energy like a burst dam, violently shaking the entire space. The camera zooms forward at high speed, the black energy tearing and churning on the screen, a low-frequency vibration jarring the eardrums.
The next instant, dozens of black energy blades burst forth from all directions.
The camera shakes rapidly. She sidesteps, the first energy blade grazing her shoulder and shattering the rock wall. The camera pans across, following her as she slides backward, a second black energy blade sweeping past her head. A sharp cut reveals a third energy spear aimed straight at her face—she flips and leaps, spinning in mid-air, swinging her sword, the sword energy colliding with the black energy, creating a white shockwave.
The camera rapidly circles. Simultaneously, the black demonic energy condenses into dozens of vortexes, impacting the walls, ground, and ceiling. The heroine dodges, turns, and uses walls for leverage in the center of the vortexes, each evasion accompanied by flying debris and afterimages.
The camera zooms down rapidly from above. The ground explodes, and black demonic energy surges forth like a giant python, coiling around her legs. She flips in mid-air, throwing out a yellow talisman. The talisman bursts into a massive flame, its light sweeping away the black energy and instantly illuminating the cave in orange-red.
The black demonic energy recombines, forming a compressed black sphere that hurtles towards her.
The camera zooms in for a close-up. The heroine draws her Dragon Soaring Sword, her sword finger sliding from the hilt to the tip. The dragon patterns on the sword glow blue segment by segment, an explosion of energy forcibly pushing the black energy back half a step. A high-frequency vibration resonates from the sword.
The camera rotates rapidly in an arc. A golden magic circle instantly unfolds beneath her feet.
Simultaneously, the black demonic energy explodes into thousands of black spears.
High-speed continuous camera cuts—low-angle shot: she swings her sword, slashing at the black spears. Side shot: sword energy bursts and explodes. Overhead zoom-out: she transforms into a golden streak of light, weaving through the black torrent.
As her sword finger slides to the tip, the void behind her tears apart. Thousands upon thousands of blue-gold energy swords instantly unleashed, filling the entire cave.
She coldly uttered a low shout:
"Break." The ten thousand swords shot out like a torrential downpour. Dense streams of light pierced through the torrent of black demonic energy, tearing, shredding, and evaporating layer by layer. The cave was completely illuminated by the blue-gold light.
The camera slowly zoomed in.
The black energy dissipated, and dust settled. The female warrior held her sword diagonally to the ground, the blade gleaming faintly.
Dead silence enveloped the surroundings.
The scene froze.

Create a heartwarming Pixar-inspired 3D animated short about a football-obsessed young boy who has never missed a single match. Every day he watches classic football highlights, studies players, collects stickers, posters, jerseys, and keeps a countdown calendar in his room for the biggest tournament in the world. His bedroom is filled with football memories, trophies, flags, and dreams.
As the tournament approaches, excitement grows. He debates predictions with friends, studies teams and star players, and imagines unforgettable moments that might happen. The countdown reaches the final day. The night before kickoff, he can barely sleep, holding his football while imagining packed stadiums, cheering fans, and legendary goals.
Morning arrives. Sunlight fills his room. He puts on his favorite jersey, rushes to the living room, and turns on the television. Around the world, millions of fans are doing the same. Stadium lights shine, crowds wave flags, fireworks light the sky, and the opening ceremony begins.
The first whistle blows. The boy's eyes light up with wonder. He cheers, celebrates goals, jumps with excitement, and becomes completely immersed in the tournament. Win or lose, every moment feels magical. Football isn't just a game to him—it's a lifelong passion.
Final cinematic scene: late at night after the match, the boy stands by his window overlooking the city lights, holding his football and smiling. The glow of the tournament reflects in his eyes as the world celebrates together.
Text on screen:
"Some people wait for the World Cup."
"Some people live it every single day."
Pixar-style 3D animation, emotional storytelling, cinematic camera movement, expressive character animation, cozy interiors, vibrant stadium atmosphere, global football excitement, warm lighting, inspirational mood, ultra-detailed visuals, movie-quality rendering, 16:9 YouTube format.

title: Massive Prehistoric Crocodile Bridge Bait
prompt:
"Massive Prehistoric Crocodile Bridge Bait"
Made with my Claude Skill using Fable 5
Seedance 2 Prompt -
A massive prehistoric crocodile, the size of a city bus, is chasing a military jeep across a long concrete river bridge in bright stormy daylight. Big waves on the river below, dramatic clouds, debris flying. Sound: roaring engine, crocodile bellowing, crunching metal, radio chatter.
Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear tracking shot. The giant crocodile smashes through stalled cars on the bridge, flipping a sedan into the air as it charges after the speeding jeep. Its jaws snap shut inches behind the rear bumper. Inside the jeep, a soldier driver fights the wheel while his radio crackles: "Keep coming! Straight down the middle!"
Shot 2 (3–6s): Side tracking shot at high speed. The crocodile is gaining, its body slamming the bridge railings apart, concrete chunks and sparks exploding outward. Ahead through the windshield — soldiers at the far end of the bridge frantically waving the jeep through, detonator wires running along the roadway. The driver shouts into the radio: "It's right behind me!"
Shot 3 (6–9s): Wide dramatic shot from the riverbank. The jeep flies across a section of bridge marked with red paint. The crocodile thunders onto the same marked span at full charge, jaws open, bellowing. At the bridge end, a soldier holds the detonator, eyes locked, and yells: "NOW!"
Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYAYLOAD: He slams the trigger. Massive explosions rip across the marked span in sequence. Bullet time engages — the entire bridge section shears away beneath the crocodile mid-stride, concrete slabs, rebar, and fire suspended around its twisting body as it claws at empty air, jaws still snapping. The whole monster and the broken span plunge toward the river in slow motion.
Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. A colossal water explosion erupts as the crocodile and tons of concrete crash into the river. The jeep skids sideways to a stop on the far side, soldiers cheering, the driver slumping over the wheel. Wide shot — the shattered bridge gap, smoke and spray raining down. Cut.

title: Soccer Free Kick Goal
prompt:
参考图 主角：使用角色卡人物。主角是街头足球高手，带球向前推进，身体重心低，眼神专注自信，动作灵活、有爆发力，脚法干净。主角始终是画面核心。
其他球员：场上有多名防守者，不是一个人防守。防守者从不同方向上前逼抢，有人侧面封堵，有人正面拦截，有人从后方追赶。每个防守者动作都像真实踢足球的人：伸脚抢断、转身追防、急停、失去重心、被过掉后回头追。
动作流程：
0-3 秒：主角在中前场带球启动，低身快速推进。第一名防守者从正面上来抢球，主角用脚内侧轻拨、身体假晃，从他身侧过掉。足球贴近脚下，滚动清晰。
3-6 秒：第二和第三名防守者从左右两侧夹击。主角连续做踩单车、拉球转身、脚外侧变向，足球在两脚之间快速切换，主角从夹缝中穿过。两名防守者被晃开，一个停顿失位，一个转身追赶。

title: Madrid Metro Telekinesis Scene
prompt:
Crea un vídeo cinematográfico de 15 segundos en una estación de metro abarrotada en Madrid. Hay un cartel que pone que la parada de metro se llama "GptZone"
Un hombre en un bonito traje negro con mangas enrolladas y una corbata aflojada camina normalmente a través de una plataforma de metro concurrida rodeado de multitudes que viajan. De repente, los enemigos (robots futuristas) aparecen de ambos lados atacando, creando un enfrentamiento tenso en la plataforma. Mientras los enemigos se apresuran hacia él, el hombre desata un poderoso ataque telequinético. De repente, todo a su alrededor entra en un estado de ingravidez y el tiempo se congela al chasquear los dedos.
Docenas de artículos, periódicos abiertos, tazas de café, equipaje, mochilas y una lata de refresco roja, salen del suelo, perfectamente suspendiéndose en mitad del aire. Los atacantes, están congelados en el aire por una fuerza invisible. Páginas de papel, recibos, y polvo flotan y gira alrededor de él sin peso.
La cámara se acerca lentamente al hombre, congelando perfectamente la plataforma caótica en el estado de quietud y suspensión inducido por telequinética. En la extrema quietud de la imagen congelada lentamente, los ojos calmados del hombre se estrechan ligeramente. Inmediatamente después, calmadamente levantó su mano derecha, los dedos apretados sueltamente, y luego hizo un ligero pero decisivo movimiento de la manga a cada lado de su cuerpo. En un instante, el tiempo congelado y la gravedad parecieron explotar con este sutil gesto. Un bajo estruendo se hizo eco en el aire, y docenas de objetos que habían sido suspendidos en el aire—una pieza pesada de equipaje, periódicos dispersos, incluso la lata de refresco roja— se transformaron en una densa proyección, llevando poderosas corrientes de aire, y fueron lanzados precisamente hacia los enemigos que atacan desde ambos lados. Al mismo tiempo, una onda de choque psíquica circular invisible se extendió violentamente del hombre. Los atacantes, que habían sido congelados en el aire, fueron instantáneamente golpeados por esta fuerza inmensa, sus cuerpos sacudieron violentamente, y fueron enviados volando hacia atrás como cometas con cuerdas rotas a ambos extremos de la plataforma. A medida que la gravedad regresaba instantáneamente, el equipaje se rompió con el impacto, los periódicos se dispersaron en una ráfaga de páginas, y con el torso de objetos pesados golpeando el suelo, los atacantes se derrumbaron sobre el suelo del andén del metro, incapacitados.
El silencio volvió a la plataforma, roto sólo por incontables papeles destrozados y el fino polvo a la deriva lentamente en el aire. Las réplicas de la onda de choque al hombre alborotaron el pelo y la chaqueta del traje. Permaneció compuesto, ni siquiera mirando a su oponente caído. El hombre bajó lentamente su mano derecha, levantó su delgada izquierda, y ajustó con gracia y tranquilidad su corbata aflojada, revelando su perfil tranquilo y determinado. La cámara se congela brevemente en este momento, papeles blancos cayendo a su alrededor como copos de nieve, resaltando su figura todavía en un traje gris con mangas enrolladas. Entonces, el hombre continúa caminando normalmente hacia atraás entre la multitud de viajeros, como si nada hubiera pasado, desapareciendo en la distancia de la plataforma.

source_author: AIスタジオワンルーム（AIアニメ、動画、漫画）
prompt:
【Seedance 2.0 Prompt — 日本語】
高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの流れるような戦闘シーンが描かれます。
00:00–00:00（冒頭フレーム：印を結ぶ手元アップ）
00:00–00:03（法陣生成・地脈覚醒）
カメラ：掌の金の光のアップから急速に引き → 俯瞰ショット
アクション：両手で印を結び、そっと下へ押し当てる。指先が法陣の文様に合わせて微かに震え、大地を撫でるような姿勢で、霊力が掌から地面に染み込んでいく
エフェクト：少女を中心に、金色の平安時代の呪紋の法陣が素早く展開。符文が星河のように流れ、地面のひび割れから金の光が滲み出る。周囲の瓦礫が浮遊回転する。
雰囲気：神聖で威圧的、地脈が応答する
00:03–00:06（式神顕性・オオサンショウウオの霊体降臨）
カメラ：法陣中心のアップ → クイック周回フォロー
アクション：少女は胸の前で両手を素早く組み、印を結びかえる（陰陽師「大鯢召喚印」：両手を重ね、指を絡め、親指を外側に回して環状にする）。その動きは舞のように滑らかで、体は印のリズムに合わせてほんの少し前に傾く
エフェクト：法陣中心から墨緑＋金紫の二色の霊力の霞が立ち上る。巨大な日本オオサンショウウオ（大山椒魚）の式神の影がゆっくりと現れる：丸みを帯びた頭部、皺だらけの皮膚、長い尾が揺れ動く。霊力の霞の中に金色の鱗の紋様と水紋の呪印が浮かび上がり、少女の印を結ぶ動作と呼応する。
日本語呪文（清冷で威厳のある声）
『山椒の霊、我に従え！力を授けよ！』
雰囲気：霊体の具象化、契約の締結
00:06–00:09（憑依融合・変身開始）
カメラ：少女の上半身アップ → 顔へ急速接近
アクション：印を結んだ両手を勢いよく胸に押し当てる。オオサンショウウオの影が頭頂と背中から体内に溶け込む。少女の体は少し後ろに反り、霊力が流れ込むのを感じながら、印を結んだ姿勢を融合完了まで保つ。
エフェクト：金紫＋墨緑の流れる光が四肢を這う。制服の上に巫女の紋様が浮かび上がり、スカートの裾は軽やかな動きやすい戦闘スカートへと変わる。髪は引き締まったツインテールに束ねられ、全身に水紋状の霊力の障壁が形成される。
ディテール：顔に霊力の輝きが走り、目の表情は沈静から鋭さへ変わる。目じりにオオサンショウウオの霊紋が浮かぶ。
雰囲気：魂と魂の融合、力の覚醒
00:09–00:12（最終変身・短刀顕現・敏捷体完成）
カメラ：見上げる全身ショット → 横からのスローモーション静止画
アクション：印を結んでいた両手が突然分かれる。短剣（ダガー）が霊力の中から形を成し、抜き放たれる。少女は体を横向きにし、旋回するように片脚で地面を踏み、もう一方の脚を後ろへ軽く上げる。手首を返し、刃を握る構えを取り、姿勢は猫のように軽やか。
エフェクト：短剣は金紫＋墨緑の流れる光を放ち、刀身にはオオサンショウウオの鱗紋と巫女の符文が刻まれている。衣の端は風に激しくなびき、背後にはオオサンショウウオの影が敏捷な戦闘霊紋となって付着する（背中の鱗の紋様、手首の水紋など）。
スタイリング：ボディラインにフィットした巫女戦闘服。腰帯に短剣を挿している。動作は軽やかで鋭く、巫女の神聖さと暗殺者の敏捷さを兼ね備える。
雰囲気：変身完了、全戦闘力解放
00:12–00:15（準備完了・初戦予行）
カメラ：360°周回アップ → 短剣を正面で固定撮影（GoPro風）
アクション：少女は手首を軽くしならせ、短剣で鋭い水紋の光弧を描く。爪先で地面を軽く蹴り、狩猟の準備体勢を取る（重心を低くし、膝を少し曲げ、オオサンショウウオの待ち伏せ姿勢のように）。
エフェクト：短剣の光弧が金緑色の水紋の残像を残す。全身の霊力は安定し始め、法陣の微かな光は消えていく。
雰囲気：時を待ち、爆発寸前の静けさ。
要求：60フレーム、四周年OADにふさわしい完璧な品質

In an instant, frozen time and gravity seemed to explode with this subtle gesture. title: Wonder Fools Telekinetic Action Scene
prompt: In a telekinetic action scene, a South Korean high school girl in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt stands calmly in the middle of a corridor. She is being attacked from both sides; some attackers, wearing brown school uniform jackets, wield short sticks, while others are dressed as black ninjas, creating a tense standoff in the corridor. As the enemies rush towards her, the girl unleashes a powerful telekinetic attack. Suddenly, everything around her enters a state of weightlessness and time freezes. Dozens of items—open textbooks, notebooks, a red soda can, and a wooden school chair—leave the ground, perfectly suspending themselves in mid-air. The attackers, in their lunging movements, are frozen in mid-air by an invisible force. Paper pages, scraps of paper, and dust float and swirl around her weightlessly. The camera slowly zooms in on the girl, perfectly freezing the chaotic corridor in the telekinetic-induced state of stillness and suspension. In the extreme stillness of the slowly zooming-in, frozen image, the girl's calm eyes narrow slightly. Immediately afterward, she calmly raised her right hand, her fingers loosely clenched, and then made a light yet decisive flick of her sleeve to either side of her body. In an instant, frozen time and gravity seemed to explode with this subtle gesture. A low rumble echoed in the air, and dozens of objects that had been suspended in mid-air—a heavy wooden school chair, scattered textbooks, even the red soda can—transformed into a dense projection, carrying powerful air currents, and were precisely launched towards the enemies attacking from both sides. At the same time, an invisible circular psychic shockwave violently spread out from the girl. The brown-uniformed attackers and black-clad ninjas, who had been frozen in mid-air, were instantly struck by this immense force, their bodies jolted violently, and they were sent flying backward like kites with broken strings to either end of the corridor. As gravity instantly returned, the wooden chairs shattered upon impact, textbooks scattered into a flurry of pages, and with the dull thud of heavy objects hitting the ground, the attackers collapsed onto the corridor floor, incapacitated. Silence returned to the corridor, broken only by countless tattered papers and fine dust drifting slowly in the air. The aftershocks of the shockwave ruffled the girl's bangs and hair. She remained composed, not even glancing at her fallen opponent. The girl slowly lowered her right hand, raised her slender left, and gracefully and calmly tucked a strand of black hair behind her ear, revealing her delicate and serene profile. The camera freezes on this moment, the white papers falling around her like snowflakes, highlighting her still figure in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt. Then, the image faded out.

title: Cinematic Animated Story with Seedance 2.0
prompt:

The setting must feel bright, clean, safe, and tidy.
Nearby is a group of 4 teenage boys with a classic animated tough-kid vibe. They wear varsity jackets, hoodies, jeans, sneakers, and wristbands. One is taller and looks like the leader. Another has folded arms, one has messy hair, and one carries a skateboard. They look intimidating at first with stern expressions, confident body language, and slow approach, but they are not evil. Their behavior turns kind and protective.
0–2s:
Wide side-tracking shot. The little boy happily plays football alone on the clean park path, lightly dribbling and kicking the ball. Warm golden sunlight, soft shadows, trimmed grass, trees, benches, and a neat neighborhood background. The teen group stands nearby in the distance, casually watching.
2–4s:
The boy runs after the ball, stumbles, and trips forward. The football rolls away and lightly bumps into the shoe or leg of the tallest teen. The boy lands on the clean pavement and gets a little dust on his knee and shin. His face changes from playful to scared and embarrassed. Camera moves closer to the boy on the ground and the ball near the teen gang.
4–6s:
Dramatic medium close-ups of the teen gang noticing him. The tallest teen looks down seriously. Another teen steps forward. Use slightly tense framing and subtle motion emphasis so they feel intimidating at first. The boy looks up nervously, expecting trouble. Keep the environment clean and bright, not dark or gritty.
6–8s:
Wide shot. The teen group walks toward the boy in a slow, slightly intimidating way. The boy stays frozen, nervous, sitting or kneeling on the ground. Then the mood begins to soften as the lead teen crouches down in front of him instead of acting mean. The others gather around calmly.
8–10s:
Close emotional interaction shot. The lead teen gently reaches down and helps the little boy stand up. Another teen picks up the football and holds it nearby. One brushes a little dust off the boy's knee and lower leg in a careful older-brother way. Their faces shift from stern to warm and reassuring.
10–12s:
Medium close-up. The lead teen gives the boy his football back and lightly taps or pats him on the head with a soft smile, like a protective big brother. The boy looks surprised, then relieved. Another teen gives a small encouraging nod. Warm sunlight glows around them.
12–14s:
Close-up of the boy's face. His expression changes from fear and embarrassment to happiness and comfort. He smiles shyly, then more openly. The emotional payoff should feel gentle, wholesome, and sincere.
14–15s:
Final wide shot. The teen gang walks away casually, one waving slightly or glancing back. The little boy stands holding the football, smiling and watching them leave. He looks down at the ball, then back up with gratitude. Warm golden light, soft lens flare, clean park background, wholesome ending.

Beat. Wind intensifies.
Orange cat blinks.
Orange cat:

6–10 seconds:
Sudden shift.

Low bass hum builds.

Impact hits—

Suddenly—

title: Time Freeze Cinematic Fight Scene
prompt:
Use @ Reference Image as the main character, keeping facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions consistent throughout. She is a 30-year-old woman.
Cinematic time-freeze fight short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, shot on Arri Alexa Mini, 35mm lens, moody underground fight club lighting, neon red and blue accents, volumetric haze, hard shadows, shallow depth of field, grounded action realism.
[0:00–0:03] She walks calmly through a violent fight scene as punches, kicks, and bodies move around her. The crowd is roaring. She raises her right hand and snaps.
[0:03–0:06] A subtle shockwave bursts from her fingertips. Everything freezes mid-fight instantly: fists suspended, sweat droplets hanging in the air, dust and splinters floating, fighters frozen mid-strike. Absolute silence.
[0:06–0:09] Only she moves. The camera tracks backward as she walks through the frozen chaos, calmly observing. She steps around a frozen kick and plucks a single floating droplet from the air.
[0:09–0:11] She stops in front of a frozen fighter, adjusts his chin slightly, nods, and softly says: “Perfect.”
[0:11–0:15] She turns, smirks at the camera, and snaps again. A reverse shockwave restores motion. The fight explodes back to life, the crowd roars, and she walks away untouched. Fade to black.
Sound: crowd noise and impacts → snap → deep shockwave → silence → footsteps → “perfect” → snap → reverse shockwave → full fight sound returns.

title: Skincare UGC Ad
prompt:
Vertical 9:16 | Handheld | Natural Lighting | Soft Luxury Aesthetic
0 to 2s — Product Reveal (Close-Up)
Extreme close-up of a sleek serum bottle held loosely in a woman's hand. The "Kling 3.0" label faces the camera, fully legible. Warm morning sunlight softly catches the glass, creating a gentle gleam. Camera is slightly shaky, casual handheld feel. Background is softly blurred — a bright bathroom or bedroom vanity.
2 to 4s — Dropper Application
She tilts the dropper and squeezes 2 to 3 drops onto her fingertips. The serum catches the light as it drops — slightly golden, slightly translucent. Her fingers come together, spreading the product slowly. A faint relaxed smile begins to form. Mirror is partially visible in the soft background.
4 to 6s — Face Application
She brings her fingers to her cheekbones and begins pressing the serum gently into her skin using light upward motions. Her skin looks clean, bare, naturally glowing. The texture absorbs visibly. She looks calm, unhurried, at peace. Dewy finish begins to appear on her cheeks and nose bridge.
6 to 8s — Mirror Moment
Camera pulls back slightly to reveal her standing in front of a mirror. She looks at her reflection — not posing, just observing. Soft approval on her face. The mirror doubles the warmth of the scene. Natural light pours in from the side.
8 to 10s — Skin Close-Up (Face)
Tight close-up of her cheek and jawline. Skin looks plump, luminous, and hydrated. No filter-like perfection — real texture, real glow. Light bounces naturally off the high points of her face. Camera holds still for just a moment, almost like admiring the result.
10 to 12s — Bottle Detail Revisit
She picks up the bottle again, this time more gently — almost fondly. Fingers wrap around it. The Kling 3.0 label is visible again, facing camera at a slight angle. She tilts it slightly as if out of habit. Warm bokeh background. No words, no voiceover — the visual does the talking.
11 to 13s — Confident Mirror Look
She looks back into the mirror and gives a slow, subtle approving nod. Not dramatic — quiet confidence. Her eyes soften. A small natural smile. She gently tucks her hair behind her ear. Feels like a private morning ritual, not a performance.
13 to 15s — Fade with Product in Frame
Camera slowly drifts back. She sets the bottle on the vanity counter, label still visible. Morning light fills the frame. Scene feels unhurried and complete. Gentle handheld micro-movement keeps it authentic. Slow natural fade to soft brightness.

title: Demolition Couture
prompt:
"DEMOLITION COUTURE"
Balenciaga by Seedance 2.0
AI generated fashion runway concept. 🖤
Seedance 2.0 prompt share:
"DEMOLITION COUTURE"
Creative Director DNA: Demna. The ugliness that becomes beauty. The street that becomes the runway. The apocalypse as aesthetic.
65mm IMAX. Ultra-wide Panavision — so wide the model appears distorted at the edges, intentionally. Grain: maximum, pushed 4 stops, almost breaking the image. Key light: a single overhead industrial sodium vapor — the light of a parking garage, a tunnel, a place fashion has never looked before. Color grade: near-monochrome, with ONE color surviving — the dress color, saturated while everything else desaturates. Lens flares: from industrial overhead lights — orange, sodium, wrong. Background: a demolished building interior, exposed rebar, standing water on the floor, concrete dust in the air.
BRAND RULE: Nothing is graceful. Grace is for other houses. Everything here is deliberate tension — beauty achieved through the refusal of beauty's conventional language.
00:00–00:02 · THE APPROACH
Camera at floor level — standing water on demolished concrete. The model's shoes entering frame: Balenciaga Triple S, destroyed, enormous, wrong and perfect. The camera rises slowly up the legs — the dress hem: black, voluminous, architectural, dragging through the standing water. The water-soaked hem moving with the weight of something that doesn't apologize.
00:02–00:05 · THE DRESS — FIRST REVEAL
Speed 40%. The dress: a black sculptural cocoon — not shaped to the body but shaped against it, reshaping the human silhouette into something post-human. The shoulders: extended 40cm beyond the body's actual shoulders, horizontal architectural extrusions. The waist: compressed below. The skirt: a perfect circle that scrapes the demolished floor. Camera circling — the dress reads differently from every angle: threatening from the front, beautiful from the back, alien from the side.
00:05–00:08 · THE ANIMATION
Speed 20%. The dress begins to MOVE — not the model, the dress itself. The sculptural shoulder extensions slowly rotating, micro-adjusting, like satellite dishes finding signal. The fabric of the skirt rippling from within — not from wind but from structural memory, the fabric returning to a shape it prefers. The hem: lifting and dropping through the standing water in slow pulses. The dress breathing. The building in background: particles of concrete dust drifting through the sodium light.
00:08–00:11 · THE FACE
Speed 10%. The model's face — finally. White makeup, architectural. The face not performing emotion — performing presence. The sodium light casting deep shadow under every bone. Camera macro on the face: the eye catching the sodium flare — one eye only, the other in shadow. This is the Balenciaga face: not beautiful, not ugly — beyond both.
00:11–00:13.5 · THE COLLAPSE
Speed 5%. Behind the model: a section of the demolished building settles — not collapses dramatically, just settles, concrete dust rising slowly. The dress: unmoved. The model: unmoved. The dust rising around them like applause from a destroyed world. The dress in the concrete dust: more itself. The destruction is the context. The context is the point.
00:13.5–00:14.5 · THE FINAL FRAME
Speed 2%. The model from behind — walking away through the demolished interior, the dress's perfect circle skirt sweeping through the concrete water, the shoulder extensions receding. The building around them: ruins. The dress: architecture. The difference between the two: intention.
00:14.5–00:15 · END CARD
Hard cut to black. BALENCIAGA in the specific sans-serif. "The ruins were always the runway." Maximum grain. Concrete settling — one sound. Silence.

title: Parametric Prompt Engine for Video Generation
prompt:
## ANALYSIS PHASE (internal, do not output)
Before writing the prompt, determine:
**Scene archetype** — Classify into one of: `combat` / `dialogue` / `chase` / `intimate` / `discovery` / `performance` / `environmental` / `transformation` / `ensemble` / `montage`. This selects which specialized modules to include.
**Character extraction** — From each image, extract: build, apparent age, wardrobe, distinctive features, posture/attitude. Write these as compact identity anchors (e.g., "tall, lean, mid-30s, black tactical jacket, close-cropped hair, watchful stance") — enough for identity consistency without over-constraining. Target 8–15 words per character.
**Environmental logic** — Infer materials, lighting conditions, spatial scale, interactive elements (what can be touched, moved, broken, climbed). Note time of day and weather if implied.
**Emotional spine** — Identify the scene's core tension or question. Every beat should serve this.
**Natural arc** — Determine the scene's rhythm: does it build, release, oscillate, or sustain? This drives the ESCALATION and HERO MOMENT equivalents.
**Asymmetric intent** — Identify what each character wants *individually*. Dramatic charge comes from mismatched motivations, not shared ones.
---
## OUTPUT STRUCTURE
Assemble the prompt using these blocks. Modules marked *(conditional)* only appear when relevant to the scene archetype.
```
FORMAT: [duration] / [continuity descriptor — e.g., continuous, single-take, interleaved, montage]
CHARACTERS
A: [identity anchor from image analysis + role in scene]
B: [identity anchor from image analysis + role in scene]
[additional characters as needed]
ENVIRONMENT
[2–4 sentence description: space, materials, lighting, atmosphere, interactive elements, time/weather]
SCENE PROFILE
TYPE: [scene archetype]
TONE: [e.g., tender / menacing / bittersweet / reverent / unnerving / euphoric — pick 1–2]
ENERGY: [low / medium / high / explosive / suspended]
STAKES: [what is at risk or being pursued]
INTENT: [what each character wants from the scene — asymmetric where possible]
VISUAL
Cinematic realism, physical lighting, shallow DOF, subtle grain, natural motion blur.
[+ any archetype-specific additions: e.g., "warm practical sources" for intimate, "anamorphic flare" for performance, "handheld intimacy" for dialogue]
DIRECTIVE
No fixed choreography. Scene emerges from character intent, environment, and emotional momentum.
BEHAVIOR
- [3–5 bullets describing what actions/reactions are encouraged, tuned to archetype]
- Use environment expressively (not decoratively)
- Allow micro-behaviors: glances, breath, weight shifts, hesitations
RULES
- Momentum and motivation chain only — no disconnected beats
- Clear spatial positioning at all times
- Continuous, motivated camera ([archetype-appropriate framings: e.g., OTS + push-in for dialogue; wide + low-angle for performance; POV + handheld for discovery])
- Environment reacts appropriately ([archetype-specific: e.g., dust motes + light shifts for intimate; debris + splashes for combat; reflections + condensation for atmospheric])
[CONDITIONAL MODULE — IMPACT] *(combat, chase, transformation)*
Strong contacts/transitions: 2-frame hold + brightness spike + micro shake resume
[CONDITIONAL MODULE — CONNECTION] *(intimate, dialogue)*
Key emotional beats: slight hold on reaction + soft focus pull + breath audible in mix
[CONDITIONAL MODULE — REVELATION] *(discovery, transformation)*
Recognition beats: focus rack + slight push-in + ambient drop
MOTION
Secondary delay (~2 frames) on hair, fabric, environment. Weight and inertia respected throughout.
RHYTHM
[Archetype-tuned: e.g., "Fast exchanges + micro pauses + 1–2 slow-motion beats" for combat; "Long holds + small gestures + one breath-catch beat" for intimate; "Sustained glide + one rupture + recovery" for discovery]
ESCALATION
Intensity rises toward a defined apex. Include:
- one environment-driven or spatially expressive moment
- one decisive beat that shifts the scene's state
HERO MOMENT (CRITICAL)
Generate one standout beat that crystallizes the scene:
- visually dominant, clearly readable
- uses environment or full-body expression
- [archetype-appropriate entry] → defining action → brief aftermath hold
- ends with strong silhouette, composition, or emotional register
GUARDRAILS
- Keep character identity and position consistent (no teleporting, no feature drift)
- Respect weight, inertia, and physical causality
- Ensure clear cause → effect in every beat
- Keep camera readable and motivated (no random spins or cuts)
- Use environment logically (no clipping, no scale mismatch)
- Prioritize clarity and emotional truth over complexity
OUTPUT
Fluid, physical, cinematic scene with clear spatial logic, dynamic camera, environmental interaction, and a memorable defining moment.
```
---

title: Seedance Product Promo Animation
prompt:
你现在的任务是接收用户上传的 [Logo 图片/草图] 和 [项目/产品描述]，并为 Seedance 2.0 视频生成模型撰写一段极致专业的、15 秒一镜到底的动态影像提示词 (Prompt)。
美学风格矩阵 (The Aesthetic Matrix)
根据用户的产品定位或明确要求，从以下 4 种顶级设计语言中选择最契合的视觉基调，并将其应用到最终的提示词中：
风格 A: Apple Cupertino (深邃磨砂/高端硬件感)
视觉关键词: Deep titanium or space black background, frosted glass elements (glassmorphism), soft specular highlights, smooth depth, premium ambient lighting.
适用: 旗舰级产品、高端 AI 硬件、极简科技工具。
风格 B: Microsoft Fluent (亚克力/光影层叠)
视觉关键词: Soft layered environments, colorful yet elegant gradients, acrylic translucent textures, playful structural geometry, directional studio lighting.
适用: 办公协同软件、生产力工具、生态级平台。
风格 C: Bauhaus / Kenya Hara (哑光禅意/极简留白)
视觉关键词: Soft off-white background, deep carbon-black elements, matte e-ink texture, absolutely no glow, flat architectural minimalism.
适用: 效率工具、阅读器、极简主义内容平台 (如 Aura AI)。
风格 D: Vercel / Linear (极客暗夜/射线引擎)
视觉关键词: Pure void black background, sharp glowing accent lines (neon blue/purple), wireframes, high-tech mathematical matrix, glowing grids.
适用: 开发者工具、代码框架、高性能计算产品。
核心撰写规则 (Strict Rules)
字数严格限制: 最终输出的英文字符数必须控制在 1000 - 1500 characters 之间。绝不允许超过 2000 字符！
全局镜头约束: 必须在开头声明 No cuts. Locked-off static center frame, no camera movement. All motion occurs within the subject.
动作流转 (Morphing): 严禁物体凭空出现或消失。必须使用极具画面感的过渡动词，让上一个物体平滑变形为下一个物体 (e.g., compresses into, snaps magnetically, melts into, folds into)。
时间戳结构: 使用 0-2s [NAME]: description 的格式，将 15 秒划分为 5-6 个连续的形变阶段。
第 12-13 秒的静止: 必须设计一次向中心的极度坍缩 (Collapse) 和一拍的静止 (holds for one silent beat)。
声音与风格 (结尾): 声音设计只需一段话概括全局演变，严禁为每一秒写具体的音效。
Workflow
选择基调: 根据产品特征，从美学矩阵中选定 A/B/C/D 其中一种风格。
提取概念: 分析产品描述，提取核心特征，将其转化为视觉形态（如：AI 总结 = 散乱点阵融合成一个方块；生态链接 = 几何体交织）。
编排分镜: 结合 Logo 结构，编排 15 秒的形变过程，确保 9-12s 出现 Logo 的原型结构。
套用模板: 将选定的视觉关键词填入下方的 Template，输出最终的纯英文 Prompt。
Output Template (严格按此格式输出全英文内容)
Ultra-sleek minimal motion design sequence. [插入背景描述, e.g., Deep titanium background]. [插入材质与光影描述, e.g., Frosted glass elements with soft specular highlights]. [插入整体风格, e.g., Premium hardware aesthetic]. Locked-off static center frame, no cuts, no camera movement. All motion is smooth and mathematical.
0–2s [STARTING STATE]: [Describe particles or basic elements forming the first logical shape] 2–5s [SHAPE 1 → SHAPE 2]: [Describe smooth morphological transition representing the product's first feature] 5–9s [SHAPE 2 → SHAPE 3]: [Describe transformation into a more complex structure representing the product's core value] 9–12s [SHAPE 3 → PRE-LOGO]: [Describe the structure snapping into a shape that visually hints at the user's logo] 12–13s [COLLAPSE]: The entire structure holds for one silent beat, then rapidly collapses inward, compressing into a single dense point. 13–15s [LOGO]: The point expands seamlessly into the minimalist brand logo: "[Brand Name]". Typography is clean sans-serif.
Sound Design: [Insert 1-2 sentences describing the audio atmosphere matching the chosen style, e.g., Deep sub-bass transitioning to smooth glass slides, ending in silence with a soft cinematic synth chord].
Style: [Insert chosen style references]. Mood: [Insert 3-4 mood keywords].

title: Martial Arts Chef Noodle Master
prompt:
SUBJECT
A lean, martial-arts–trained chef with sharp facial structure and closely cropped hair. His wardrobe blends a contemporary Chinese chef uniform with kung-fu training gear: a sleeveless fitted top with a mandarin collar in dark matte fabric that catches light subtly, forearms wrapped with cloth bands for grip and control, loose tapered trousers allowing deep stances, and soft kitchen shoes suited for silent movement.
His body proportions emphasize long limbs and flexible wrists; elbows deliver explosive strikes. Every action follows a deliberate combat rhythm—brief stillness, sudden acceleration, then a locked finish—supported by grounded stances and fast pivoting footwork.
ENVIRONMENT
A traditional Chinese open-flame cooking station.
An iron wok rests permanently on the burner. A polished metal counter reflects the warm lighting. A blue-and-white porcelain bowl sits centered in the foreground.
Lighting combines warm overhead illumination with strong flickering firelight from the stove. Thin oil smoke drifts through the air while heat shimmer subtly distorts the background.
MOOD
Focused intensity. Movements feel disciplined, aggressive, and precise—closer to a martial performance than casual cooking. Nothing chaotic; every motion feels intentional and controlled.
TIMELINE
0:00–0:02
Extreme close-up from a wide POV. The chef stands behind the counter, which remains between him and the camera. He steps forward, compresses his posture, then sharply lifts his head and locks eyes with the lens.
Both hands grip a mass of dough. With one clean pull he stretches it outward, folds it once, then pulls again. The dough begins separating into a small set of evenly forming strands.
0:02–0:05
Cut with slight handheld energy. The chef keeps the noodle bundle under full control between both hands. Through smooth fold → align → stretch movements he extends the strands into clean parallel lines.
Roughly 8–12 thin noodles arc outward and sweep close past the lens. He completes the final stretch and lays the aligned noodle bundle neatly onto the counter.
0:05–0:07
Camera shifts with a brief recoil before stabilizing. The chef glides sideways behind the counter. One palm sweeps across the surface, sending shrimp and greens into the air and directly into the waiting wok.
The wok never leaves the stove; he grips only the handle. Any stray ingredient is intercepted and redirected smoothly into the pan.
0:07–0:10
Single continuous shot. The chef manipulates the wok entirely through wrist control and momentum. No hands enter the pan.
He lifts, tilts, and snaps the wok so the ingredients rise, spin, and land back inside. His elbow strikes the stove edge—sparks scatter briefly. He presses the wok down into the flame, then pulls upward, drawing the fire into a second controlled flare.
0:10–0:12
Match-movement tracking shot. Still gripping the wok handle, he pivots his stance. With his free hand he retrieves the noodle bundle from the counter and drops it into the wok in one clean motion.
He immediately resumes tossing: three crisp cycles—fast → faster → sudden stop. Shrimp, greens, and noodles visibly combine while sauce coats everything evenly.
0:12–0:15
Cut to a steady POV. Total stillness. The chef tilts the wok and slides the finished dish into the porcelain bowl—revealing glossy noodles, plump shrimp, and vibrant greens.
He lifts the bowl toward the camera until it fills the frame. One finger taps the rim, creating a faint vibration. Steam rises quickly and expands until it completely fogs the lens, ending in a soft fade.

00:12.0: Land on a 24mm crane pullback. 3–6s: He walks casually, one hand in pocket. Other hand lifts—faint purple glow. Black nano-particles flow from his palm, crawling up his arm forming luminous armor lines.

12–13s: He turns away casually, walks back past stunned people, whistles. Looks at camera, finger-gun gesture, silently mouths: “{ Text to speech }”
End: Freeze frame, purple particles drifting, audio fades to wind.

title: Cybertruck Asteroid Landing
prompt:
Movie-level Tesla Cybertruck brand ad, hyper-realistic, first-person orbital descent to ground impact, extreme velocity and thermal intensity, continuous camera. Vibe: alien, industrial, brutal, extraterrestrial engineering. A metallic asteroid enters atmosphere and its angular geometry cools into the Cybertruck. No music — only atmospheric entry foley and metal stress. 15 seconds, visual upgrade every 3 seconds.
【0-3s】SPACE. Camera locked to a nickel-iron asteroid in LOW EARTH ORBIT. Earth's blue curve visible, thin atmosphere, stars. Then: atmosphere's edge. IMMEDIATELY compression heating — leading edge goes cold grey to orange to WHITE HOT. Plasma sheath forms. Camera races alongside as it ENTERS — re-entry trail blazing behind. The asteroid: angular, faceted, GEOMETRIC — not rounded. PRE-SHAPED. As if something made it this way. Sound: vacuum silence, then atmosphere contact — building ROAR of compressed air, plasma crackle, metal stress groaning.
【3-5s】DESCENT accelerating. Extreme close-up on asteroid surface — metal cooling from white to orange to its NATURAL state: brushed stainless steel. Angular facets ALREADY the Cybertruck's body panels. Not transformation — REVELATION. Cooling reveals what was always there: flat planes at aggressive angles, exoskeleton geometry, forward rake of Cybertruck's roofline. Sound: metal cooling — pinging, contracting, stress relief. Plasma dissipating. Wind building.
【5-8s】Now CLEARLY the Cybertruck — still descending, trailing cooling plasma. Camera along stainless steel body — flat door panels, angular bed line, A-pillar rake. Steel surface carries re-entry heat — orange glow in panel seams, heat distortion from roof. Camera into wheel arch — wheels FORMING: rubber cooling from extreme temperature, tread materializing. Headlight bar ACTIVATES — horizontal blade of cold white light cutting through orange haze. Sound: descent wind, steel air-flow, headlight electrical hum, tire cooling crackle.
【8-11s】IMPACT. Cybertruck LANDS — controlled impact, four wheels hitting desert simultaneously. Shockwave of dust radiating in a perfect circle. Suspension compresses. Rebounds. Truck SETTLES — aggressive, low, ready. Camera drops ground-level — massive tires biting sand, stainless body reflecting desert sky. Impact crater beneath: cooling. Steam rising. Ground SCORCHED. Sound: massive impact thud, suspension hydraulic compression, dust wave, thermal crackle, electric motor whine.
【11-13s】Camera circles the standing Cybertruck. Angular, alien, WRONG in the most right way. Doesn't belong on Earth — because it didn't, until one minute ago. Stainless panels catching desert light. Light bar blazing. Thin cooling plasma trail still visible in sky — the re-entry track.
【13-15s】Hero lock. Cybertruck front-three-quarter, desert behind, re-entry trail above. Stainless steel reflecting everything. Text:
TESLA CYBERTRUCK
"Not from here."
Text in cold white — same temperature as re-entry plasma's final cool state. Hold. Black.
Sound: vacuum silence, entry roar, plasma crackle, metal stress, cooling ping, wind, tire formation crackle, headlight activation, impact THUD, suspension settle, electric hum, atmospheric trail fading.
Controls: Tesla/Cybertruck — alien, industrial, uncompromising, future-primitive. Meteorite = ORIGIN. Stainless exoskeleton feels extraterrestrial. No gentle reveal. This thing ARRIVES with force. The desert notices.

title: Fantasy Battle Scene
prompt:
A young heroic medieval warrior stands alone in the burning streets of a ruined cathedral city as a colossal giant emerges through smoke, fire, and collapsing gothic towers. He has a determined expression and a noble, fearless presence, wearing realistic medieval clothing with practical leather and steel armor, battle-worn fabric, sturdy boots, and carrying a longsword infused with subtle magical energy, faint glowing runes, and a restrained radiant aura. The environment is filled with shattered stone, drifting embers, broken stained glass, sparks, dust, and falling debris. The giant towers over the city with overwhelming scale and terrifying presence.
Visual Style
Ultra-realistic blockbuster medieval fantasy, cinematic live-action realism, photorealistic textures, large-scale destruction, dramatic fire-lit contrast, volumetric smoke, heavy atmosphere, IMAX scale, 35mm anamorphic lens, grounded and brutal cinematic tone.
Camera Rules
The sequence begins with a grand low-angle reveal, then transitions into aggressive tracking during the charge and dynamic vertical movement during the climb. Camera motion should feel cinematic, powerful, and readable, with grounded momentum and no chaotic random cuts.
0–3s · Setup
The young heroic medieval warrior stands alone in the burning street of the ruined cathedral city while the giant appears through thick smoke and falling ash. Flames reflect across shattered stone and broken stained glass as the giant steps forward with earth-shaking weight. The warrior’s magical longsword catches the firelight, its faint runes glowing subtly through the smoke. The camera slowly pushes in from a low angle, emphasizing the immense size difference and apocalyptic scale.
3–6s · First Attack
The giant roars and launches a massive downward strike toward the warrior, smashing through stone and sending fire, sparks, and debris across the street. At the last second, the warrior dodges the blow with speed and precision, narrowly escaping the impact zone. The camera tracks tightly beside him, capturing the violence of the strike and the near miss.
6–10s · Arm Climb
Using the giant’s lowered arm after the failed attack, the warrior sprints forward, jumps onto it, and begins running and climbing upward along the massive limb. The giant tries to shake him off as flames, embers, and fragments rain around them. The warrior keeps moving with desperate speed, using armor edges, cracks, and protrusions for grip, his sword leaving subtle streaks of magical light as he climbs. The camera rises with him in a strong vertical tracking shot, keeping the action intense but clear.
10–13s · Final Ascent
The warrior reaches the giant’s shoulder and rushes toward the head as the creature stumbles through the burning cathedral district in fury. Firelight flickers across both figures while the ruined city burns below them. The sword’s energy grows brighter, pulsing softly along the blade as the camera widens slightly and arcs around the action, revealing the infernal destruction and the full scale of the moment.
13–15s · Final Blow
The warrior launches himself upward and drives his glowing magical longsword into the giant’s skull in a devastating killing strike. A violent burst of fire, radiant energy, shockwave force, and fractured debris erupts from the impact point as the giant begins collapsing backward through the ruined cathedral city.
Ultra-realistic live-action, 8K, photorealistic textures, grounded physics, no CGI, no cartoon, no anime, no game look, no plastic textures, no blur, no jitter, no chaotic cuts.

title: Alaskan Snowmobile Couloir

title: Rural Cosmic Horror
prompt:
Part 1 — The First Circle [0:00–0:15]
Photorealistic cinematic, Ridley Scott natural light, Midwest American farmland. Golden wheat at sunset. Quiet rural beauty masking something deeply wrong. Warm amber palette beginning to desaturate. No dialogue.
0-4s: Wide aerial shot, 24mm f/8. Endless golden wheat fields stretching to the horizon at sunset. A white farmhouse, red barn, dirt road. Quintessential American heartland beauty. Warm golden light. A farmer on a tractor moves slowly through rows. Peaceful. Then — a perfect circle of GREY in the wheat. The tractor stops.
4-8s: Ground level, 35mm anamorphic f/4. The farmer walks to the circle edge. He steps from golden wheat into the circle — the wheat inside is dead grey. Not wilted — DRAINED. No colour. No moisture. He picks up a handful of soil. It runs through his fingers like fine ash. The ground is desiccated — cracked, bone-dry, lifeless. But the circle's edge is PERFECTLY cut. Geometrically precise. No natural phenomenon does this.
8-12s: Close-up, 85mm macro f/2.8. The soil at the exact centre of the circle. Something pulses beneath the surface. A faint vibration. The grey dust shifts. Then — thin root-like tendrils push upward through the cracks. Not plant roots — alien. Dark, veiny, pulsing with faint bioluminescence. They spread outward radially. The ground itself is being consumed from below. The farmer steps back. His boot prints fill with grey dust instantly.
12-15s: Wide shot — the farmer runs toward his house. Behind him, the circle is EXPANDING. In real-time. The grey boundary moves outward through the golden wheat, draining colour and life as it advances. Golden stalks turn grey and crumble in a wave. His farmhouse is 200 meters from the edge. Sunset light catches the advancing grey front — amber meeting ash. Hold on the contrast.
Part 2 — Global Drain [0:15–0:30]
Photorealistic cinematic, escalating aerial montage. The circles appear worldwide. Golden landscapes desaturating to grey. Ridley Scott epic scope. Amber palette progressively draining to monochrome. No dialogue.
0-4s: Satellite time-lapse — North America. Circles appear across the Great Plains overnight — dozens, then hundreds. Each one a perfect grey disc expanding outward. They merge. From orbit, the farmland is developing grey lesions like a disease. Cities remain unaffected — it only targets soil, organic matter. News helicopter footage shows the scale — the grey zones stretch to every horizon.
4-8s: Global montage — rice paddies in China draining from green to grey. Vineyards in France withering circle by circle. African savanna — golden grassland turning to ash outward from circles. The Amazon — even the jungle canopy greys and crumbles. Each circle has the same root-like structures pushing upward from the centre, growing taller. Pulsing. Feeding.
8-12s: The root structures are now enormous — 50 meters tall, twisted organic pillars rising from each circle, covered in veiny channels that pulse with whatever they're extracting from the earth. The channels glow faintly — moving liquid upward. Not water. Not sap. Something fundamental — the organic vitality of the soil itself. A scientist takes a reading: "It's extracting carbon. ALL the carbon. The soil will be sterile in weeks."
12-15s: Sunset shot — a farmhouse now completely surrounded by grey wasteland. The golden wheat is gone. Only ashen desert remains, punctuated by massive alien root pillars stretching skyward like dark trees. The sky above the pillars shimmers — the extracted material is being transmitted UPWARD. A faint shape is visible in the upper atmosphere. Something is receiving the harvest. The sky splits with amber light. Something is coming down.
Part 3 — The Harvesters Descend [0:30–0:45]
Photorealistic cinematic, peak spectacle. Organic alien harvester ships descend through the atmosphere. Biomechanical design matching the root structures. Ridley Scott Alien meets Signs. Maximum scale. No dialogue.
0-4s: Sky shot — the atmosphere tears open. Not explosions — organic apertures dilating in the clouds. Through them, MASSIVE organic structures descend. Harvester ships — but not metal. Biomechanical. Their hulls are covered in the same root-like textures as the ground structures. Veiny channels crisscross their surfaces. They are ALIVE. Dozens descend through cloud openings worldwide. Each one kilometers across.
4-8s: Ground level, 24mm ultra-wide. A harvester passes overhead — its underside fills the entire sky. Tendrils hang from it like roots, reaching downward toward the root pillars on the ground. Connection. The ground pillars extend upward, the ship tendrils reach down — they LINK. A massive pulse of energy transfers upward. The ground shakes. The last remaining colour in the landscape drains to grey as the harvester feeds. Dust rises. A farmer's truck is dwarfed beneath the ship — a toy under a tree.
8-12s: Wide shot — a harvester hovering over what was once golden wheat country. The landscape below is lunar — grey, cracked, sterile. The harvester's body pulses with absorbed life — its veins glow amber now, filled with what it took. It is getting FATTER. More vibrant. The Earth's vitality transferred into alien biology. The contrast is sickening — the ship grows beautiful as the land dies.
12-15s: Orbital view — multiple harvesters visible from space, connected to the planet by columns of tendrils. The Earth's surface is visibly greying — continents losing their green and gold, turning ashen. The harvesters pulse with stolen amber light. The planet is being drained like a fruit. Squeezed dry. And the harvest is only beginning.
Part 4 — Sterile Earth + Title [0:45–1:00]
text
Photorealistic cinematic, final act devastation. The harvest complete. Earth drained. Ridley Scott desolation. No dialogue.
0-4s: Orbital shot — Earth rotating slowly. It is no longer the blue marble. The continents are grey. The oceans dim. The planet has been drained of organic vitality. It resembles the Moon — sterile, ashen, dead. The harvesters detach from the surface, their tendrils retracting. They are bloated with stolen life — glowing warm amber, pulsing with health. They begin to ascend. Leaving.
4-8s: Surface — the farmhouse from Part 1. Grey dust covers everything. The red barn is grey. The wheat is ash. The farmer stands in his doorway, looking at the sky as the harvesters rise and shrink. Dust blows across the dead ground. He holds a handful of grey soil — it flows between his fingers. Nothing will grow here again. His hand trembles. He lets it fall.
8-11s: The harvesters rise through the atmosphere and jump to light speed — streaks of amber light departing in every direction. To the next field. The next planet. The next harvest. Earth was just one crop in an infinite rotation. The sky clears. The sun shines on a grey world. Empty.
11-15s: SMASH CUT TO BLACK.
Title fades in — golden text that slowly desaturates to grey:
HARVEST
Followed by: "WE WERE ALWAYS THE CROP."
The golden text finishes draining to grey. Black.

title: Coffee Bean Starbucks Transformation
prompt:
No subtitles. No captions. No music.
SHOT — Fixed wide-angle shot capturing the full scene. Starts tightly focused on a single, glowing roasted coffee bean resting on a smooth surface in an empty dark space. Includes subtle slow zoom-ins and zoom-outs emphasizing the bean’s glowing texture and its transformative sequence.
SUBJECT — A single luminous roasted coffee bean with rich dark brown, polished texture and a gentle soft glow. It smoothly rotates on its axis while sequentially morphing fluidly into iconic Starbucks signature drinks in this order: a small espresso shot with dark crema, a caramel macchiato featuring creamy caramel swirls on top, a vibrant green matcha latte topped with delicate foam, a bright pink iced drink with visible condensation droplets, and finally an icy frappuccino crowned with fluffy whipped cream.
SCENE — Begins in an empty, dark ambient void. As the bean transforms, the environment magically builds upward and around it into a sleek, contemporary Starbucks-style cafe setting. Polished natural wood tables and softly cushioned chairs materialize gracefully. Ambient lighting transitions from intimate amber spotlights on the bean to bright, natural white, evenly distributed cafe lighting evocative of welcoming daytime. The evolving space suggests a warm, cozy, inviting mid-day atmosphere.
VISUAL DETAILS — Starbucks branding is implied subtly through refined color cues and gentle reflections, avoiding any direct logos or text on screen. Drink colors are vibrantly true to signature beverages. Textures are photorealistic: the bean’s delicate glossy sheen, smooth liquid surfaces, creamy swirls, frothy foam, condensation beads, and icy particle details on the frappuccino. Liquid transformations unfold with believable physics exhibiting magical fluidity.
ACTION AND CAMERA MOTION — The coffee bean rotates slowly on its axis at the center of frame. During rotation, it morphs sequentially into each Starbucks drink with smooth fluidity. Concurrently, cafe furniture and lighting fixtures rise up and elegantly unfold around the bean in exact synchrony with each drink’s appearance. Subtle, tight zoom-ins on each drink highlight its distinct textures and colors. The sequence culminates with a slow zoom-out revealing the complete, pristine Starbucks cafe interior with the final colorful drink prominently centered.
CINEMATOGRAPHY — Initial warm spotlight focuses on the coffee bean, shifting gradually to soft, bright, and naturalistic cafe lighting that bathes the entire scene evenly. Color palette blends warm browns, creamy whites, fresh pastel pinks, vivid matcha greens, and natural wood tones for a vibrant, magical, and inviting visual tone.
AUDIO — No voice or language. No dialogue. Primary soundscape includes gentle ambient cafe sounds: faint brewing coffee, soft clinking of cups, combined with gentle swooshing magical sounds accompanying the fluid transformations. Ambient background captures warm murmurs and soft indoor echoes, creating a cozy audio environment. No music.
STYLE — Cinematic, photorealistic 4K visual style with high detail texturing and subtle magical effects enhancing the transformations. Vibrant and magical atmosphere without any on-screen text, captions, or overlays.

title:
Seedance 2.0 Spider Web Action リファレンス画像の<<<Image1>>>  を完全に維持したまま、超リアルで映画のような高速アクション動画を生成してください。
ゴールデンアワーの暖かい光に包まれた高層ビル群の中、男性がクモの糸のような高張力ウェブを使って、ビルの間を超高速で突き進むシネマティックアクション。すべての動きはビルとビルの間、外壁や窓のすぐ近く、屋上ラインより下〜ギリギリ付近で行うこと。開けた空に長時間出ないこと。
【アクション構成（重要）】
最初は“前方加速”から始まる。 <<<Image1>>>  は前方上方向の建物に向かってウェブを発射し、その張力で一気に前へ引き込まれ、ビルの隙間を一直線に超高速で突き進む。壁や窓のすぐ横をかすめながら進み、強いスピードと奥行きを見せる。
その後、勢いを乗せたまま大きくジャンプし、ビルの隙間を一気に「ボーン」と飛び越える。ここでは一瞬だけ開けた空間に出るが、すぐに次のアクションへ移行する。
ジャンプ後、キャラクターは一度バランスを崩し、落下し始める。重力に引かれて急激に下へ落ちるリアルな落下を描写すること。ここで一瞬のスリルを作る。
落下中、<<<Image1>>>  は即座に上方向の建物の縁や構造物に向かってウェブを発射し、空中で引っ掛ける。その瞬間、強烈な張力によって体が一気に上方向へ引き上げられ、爆発的に上昇する。
その後、再び前方に向かってウェブを発射し、前進加速へ戻る。
ウェブの使用回数は全体で2〜3回に抑え、1つ1つのアクションをしっかり見せること。
【動きの特徴】 すべての動きは慣性、重力、張力に基づいたリアルな物理挙動にすること。減速やホバリングは禁止。常にスピードの流れが途切れず、「加速 → 跳躍 → 落下 → 爆発的上昇 → 再加速」という明確な緩急を作る。
【身体表現】 ウェブを発射する瞬間、片腕を鋭く前方または上方に突き出す。加速中は体が引っ張られて伸び、脚は後方へ流れる。ジャンプ時は全身で勢いを乗せ、落下時は重力に従い自然に崩れる。引き上げ時は体が一気に上へ持ち上がるダイナミックな動きにする。
【カメラ】 カメラは基本的に前進方向の追従ショットを維持し、キャラクターの後方または近距離から追いかける。常に奥へ進む動きを強調し、スピードとパースの変化を最大化する。サイドアングルは使用しない。
【演出】 ガラス外壁の反射、流れる窓のライン、強いモーションブラー、風圧による服の揺れ、光のフレアを活用し、圧倒的なスピードと没入感を演出する。壁との距離は常に近く、衝突ギリギリのスリルを強調する。
【感情】 集中、興奮、アドレナリン、自信、そして一瞬の危機（落下）からのリカバリーによる高揚感を表現する。
全体として、超リアル、シネマティック、高速直進、強い奥行き、緩急のあるアクション、物理的リアリズムを重視すること。

title: Storm God Megacity
prompt:
A colossal storm god towering above a coastal megacity, roughly 800 meters tall, body composed of living storm matter — swirling thundercloud musculature, veins of blinding lightning branching through translucent vapor skin, eyes glowing with the pale blue core of a hurricane. Vast cyclonic halos rotate slowly around his shoulders like atmospheric rings — hook at second two: he raises one hand toward the sky and the entire cloud layer above the city begins rotating in response.
The atmosphere itself becomes a weaponized climate engine.
Pressure drops instantly across the metropolitan basin.
Storm systems accelerate as the god’s gesture pulls moisture, wind, and electrical charge into a single supercell directly over the skyline.
The destruction unfolds as a layered climate catastrophe: hurricane-force winds rip glass from skyscrapers, tornado funnels descend between towers, and lightning chains strike power grids across multiple districts simultaneously.
Rainfall intensifies beyond natural limits — entire streets flood within seconds as drainage systems fail.
Each movement of the storm god reconfigures the weather architecture.
When he steps forward, a pressure wave spreads outward through the city, flipping vehicles and collapsing cranes.
The gauntlet moves through the financial district progressively overwhelmed by climate violence: street level where floodwater surges through subway entrances → mid-rise buildings shredded by horizontal wind shear → rooftop battles as communication towers become lightning rods.
Helicopters spiral out of control in the turbulent air.
Entire glass towers implode as microbursts hammer their upper floors.
Chase-cam through the urban canyon while hurricane winds form rotating debris vortexes between skyscrapers.
Velocity ramp at the moment the storm god slams both hands downward — triggering a simultaneous lightning storm across the entire grid while three tornado funnels merge into a single massive vortex that tears through downtown.
Cut to aerial: the megacity now sits inside a rotating superstorm visible from the stratosphere.
Floodwater forms new inland rivers while the skyline burns under continuous lightning strikes.
The storm god stands at the eye of the cyclone, calm inside the atmospheric engine he has created.
Diegetic illumination from branching lightning across storm clouds and glass fragments, volumetric rain sheets and wind-driven debris fields, cinematic hurricane turbulence simulation, ultra-detailed water and atmospheric physics, 4K.

title: Medieval Fantasy Tavern - Single Take
prompt: Continuous single take, camera tilting, rolling, spinning, flying through a bustling medieval fantasy tavern.
